chapters.title: Chapter 1901: I chose... the wrong... side...
paragraphs: "Wait, there is something I do not understand."
While Nux was training together with Aeliana and explaining how his version of Absolute Law of Inseparable Forever worked, Melia raised her hand in confusion.
"What is it?"
Nux questioned.
"So since this Law is an Absolute, it can only be overpowered by another Absolute Law of Higher Quality Energy, correct?"
"Yes."
"So only Primordials or stronger beings with an Absolute Law can kill you?"
Melia questioned.
"Well, that is not entirely correct, but yes, you can say that."
"What do you mean by that? Explain."
"It’s... complicated."
"Explain."
Melia repeated herself, the Vampire had no plans of backing down.
"Transcendents do not need Absolute Laws to kill me, obviously, the same goes for Eternals and Infinities.
As for Primordials..."
As Nux started, Melia listened carefully.
Primordials were the ones the Vampire actually cared about, after all, Nux won’t be going around facing Transcendents or beings at a higher level, now, will he?
That would make no sense.
"Well, some Primordials with Absolute Laws can kill me."
"Some?"
Melia raised her eyebrow.
"It depends on Intent. T
ake Amaya for example, if she breaks through and becomes a Primordial, if she devours my existence using her Law, I will truly perish.
But if it’s Vyriana,
It won’t work."
Vyriana narrowed her eyes at those words.
"Absolute means certainty of a particular Law or Concept,
For Amaya, it is simpler, Absolute Devour means that if she Devours a being, it is certain that she ’ended’ his existence.
But for Vyriana, her Absolute Strength means certainty in her Strength.
She will be the Strongest at her Level and against her strength, no one would last.
This is also the reason that despite me being physically stronger than her, she still pushes me back every time she punches me. Because her Law makes her the Strongest."
Nux explained.
He didn’t know how well he was explaining it, but he was doing his best.
"Then what about me?"
Astaria questioned with a curious look on her face.
Nux nodded at her,
"Your Absolute Sword means certainty when you cut your opponent, instead of killing, your power is more focused on piercing through one’s defenses and cutting them,
"So, a Law like mine cannot kill you either."
"Yes, it cannot."
Nux nodded.
"And me?"
Thyra questioned.
Of course, her Law wasn’t an Absolute yet, but once Nux severs her, it will be.
Nux nodded at the cat,
"Yours definitely can."
"So the only Laws that can kill you are Laws related to Primordial Energy of Death or Destruction."
Amaya simplified it.
"Yes, that is correct."
Nux nodded.
"Well, you simplified it a little too much. There are also other forms of Laws I need to be careful of."
Nux then turned towards Aeliana and,
"Her Law, for example.
While she cannot technically kill me,
She can ’control’ me and since her Control is Absolute, I cannot resist her. If she then orders me to end my own existence, I will perish.
Some Laws can also confine me, separate me from the rest of the Universe, or harm me in some other way, the Universe is vast, I cannot let my guard down.
So yes, while my Law is strong and makes me unkillable. It still comes with its own weaknesses."
"So basically, as long as the enemy does not know about this power, about its limitations and do not actively look for ways to counter it, you can come back to life in most scenarios, correct?"
Aeliana questioned.
"Yes."
Nux nodded with a confident look on his face.
"...monster."
The Vampire muttered and Nux just smiled wryly.
"Let’s just focus on my training, shall we?"
"I’ll kill you."
Aeliana threatened and this time, she wasn’t joking around.
If Nux was now an immortal, she was going to use it to her absolute advantage and train him past his limits.
Indeed, the Vampire was quite a Spartan as well.
"H-H-How..."
Faelara stared at the man in front of her in disbelief.
She...
She had killed him!
She was sure she had killed him!
Then how...
How was he alive...?
"Don’t rack your head over it."
Nux chuckled, using the Fox’s words against her.
At the same time, he pitied the woman. Your next read is at freewebnovel
He could understand the shock she must be feeling.
The Fox had truly given her all, she had used everything in her arsenal, heck, the woman had summoned a literal Black Hole in order to get rid of him...
Yet...
She failed.
Well, it wasn’t her fault.
And it definitely didn’t happen because she was weak.
She was just... unfortunate.
Her Law was unsuitable, especially against a being like Nux.
As established before, to kill Nux, she needed a Law related to Death or Destruction. And while the Black Hole did destroy him, the Absolute Concept behind it was erasing Nux’s existence.
Which it did,
But...
The monster simply ’reformed’ again.
Honestly, from the very start, Nux knew Faelara would never be able to kill him, this was also the reason he was playing around throughout the battle.
He wanted to see how far the Fox would push herself, and honestly,
She surprised him.
He was impressed.
"If it is any consolation,
Know that I’d be severely weakened after this."
"You... look fine to me..."
Faelara answered, her voice extremely weak, her eyes were barely open.
"Well, yeah."
Nux didn’t bother lying either.
"Whatever you did was pretty much useless."
"I... could never win..."
The Fox realized it.
"Yes."
Nux nodded.
A Self Depreciating smile appeared on the Fox’s face.
"I chose... the wrong... side..."
The Fox truly looked... pitiful.
Well, at least to any other onlooker.
"You know..."
Nux, however, just stared at the woman, a bit surprised by her relentlessness.
"If it didn’t work the first time, it won’t work the second time either."
He spoke and with a flick of his finger, the Black Dot formed behind him flickered out of existence.
Yes, the Fox, even in the condition she was in, summoned another Black Hole,
Still trying to kill him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1902: I love you more.
paragraphs: Faelara widened her eyes in disbelief.
She couldn’t believe it.
H-He...
He took control over the Black Hole she created using her very Life Force and... erased it out of existence as if it never existed.
Something that... shouldn’t be possible.
Even she couldn’t make the Black Hole disappear once she summoned it, then how did Nux do it!?
No, scratch that!
How did he take control over the Black Hole she created!?
How is that even possible!?
"H-H-H-How-Khaaawwwkkk!!"
The Fox tried to ask, but the moment she opened her mouth, she coughed out blood.
However, before the blood she coughed out could fall on Nux, it was stopped by an invisible barrier, a barrier Faelara recognized in an instant.
It was a Space Barrier.
"M-My L-Law..."
She barely spoke, her voice extremely hoarse as if she was using her last remaining powers to say those words.
"Well, not exactly."
Nux, however, shook his head.
"I didn’t copy your Law yet,
This one’s something I comprehended on my own, it’s probably much stronger than yours, I can pretty much do everything you did, just better."
Yes, now this shameless man was flexing on a dying woman.
"Of course, I’ll still be reading your memories and comprehending your version of Space Law as well, who knows, you might have another interesting approach I haven’t thought of till now."
Nux shrugged, then, with a wave of his hand, he used Spatial Powers to take control over the woman’s body.
Yes, it was similar to Absolute Kinesis, but... much, much stronger.
The weakened Faelara was completely reckless. Nux then took her to the dimension they had fought in before. Since the place was created by Faelara herself, it was currently a mess.
Nux, however, didn’t care.
"Come out."
He ordered as his eyes turned crimson.
And suddenly, another Fox appeared with an expressionless look on her face.
Faelara’s expression changed when she stared at her daughter.
She was the reason she had been trying to kill Nux so desperately. Even if she had to sacrifice her own life, she wanted her daughter to survive.
"S-S-Spare her..."
She requested as tears came out of her eyes.
"You know I will not do that. You two were prepared to kill me and my wives just so you can live under the Protection of the Supreme Worlds."
"I-It was my f-fau-"
Faelara tried to explain herself.
"It doesn’t matter."
Nux shook his head.
"We are similar in this regard, Faelara Dawnshade.
We will go to any lengths for the people we cherish."
Then, his eyes glimmered with a cruel glow and,
"No matter how low or cruel those lengths are."
Under Faelara’s desperate eyes, Nux placed his hands on her and Vulpiana’s faces, absorbing their memories.
The process lasted for a few seconds, and once Nux was done,
"You truly loved your daughter, huh?
Your daughter loved you too, Vulpheon’s Successor."
He spoke as he looked into Faelara’s eyes, hearing those words in her final moments put a strange smile of relief on the Mother Fox’s face.
Not wanting to stretch this any further, Nux covered her with Absolute Death energy, ending her existence once and for all.
Then,
He turned towards Faelara and,
"Your daughter loved you a lot..."
He muttered, as he recalled Vulpiana’s memories.
What he didn’t say out loud, however, was that Vulpiana ended up in this situation because of her love for her mother as well.
Yes, according to the Daughter Fox’s memories, she wanted to side with Nux, she wanted to go to Azriel and seek his protection, just like the Progenitor wanted them to.
But...
Her love for her mother was so strong she wanted to follow her, even if that meant her possible death, or the death of the man she loved.
Yes.
Vulpiana Dawnshade loved Nux Leander.
"What are you going to do?"
Felberta, who sensed Nux’s conflicted emotions, appeared next to him.
"She put you all in danger."
Nux muttered.
"She did it for her mother."
Felberta replied.
"It doesn’t matter."
Nux shook his head.
"You love her too."
Felberta spoke out loud, but...
"It doesn’t matter."
Nux’s answer was the same.
"I love you more."
His eyes shined, and the next moment, Death Energy surrounded Vulpiana Dawnshade as well, ending her existence.
Silence.
Absolute Silence fell all over the place.
After 15 long minutes, Nux finally spoke up.
"I made it painless."
Felberta nodded as she hugged him from behind.
She could sense his complicated thoughts,
She could sense his... guilt.
Yes, Nux felt guilty. Vulpiana loved him, and he saw how she inwardly broke down when he said those words before his battle with Faelara.
"It was probably for the best."
Felberta spoke as she tightened her hug around her husband.
"We killed Faelara, she would have never forgiven us for that."
Nux nodded at those words.

The two stayed silent for a while, the dimension around them cracked into pieces since its creator no longer existed. Usually, it was a dangerous place to be in; collapsing dimensions could harm even the strongest of beings.
But...
Nux was an exception.
Explore hidden tales at freewebnovel
To him, this place was as safe as it could be.
After all, even if it wasn’t his dimension, he now had the power to take over this place with a mere thought.
Yes, the Law of Absolute Space was broken.
Even stronger than the Law of Absolute Death Nux had comprehended before.
And that’s not it.
It was probably the Strongest Law throughout existence.
"Should we leave?"
Seeing that Nux was calming down, Felberta questioned.
Nux nodded, and the two disappeared into their shadows, returning to their own Universe.
With this, the Games with the Foxes were now over.
The Black Order was no more.
The Ancestral Order would now take over the Foxes, and with a bit of memory manipulation magic, the Foxes would be completely assimilated with Yrniel as their own.
Just like the Fox Progenitor wanted it to.
And while Yrniel stabilized itself,
The Four Entities representing the Four Supreme Worlds were having another meeting.

chapters.title: Chapter 1903: There can only be One Ruler.
paragraphs: Once again, inside that stupidly large room, four entities gathered on each side of the comically large table.
"It happened again."
The entity that stood in the middle of stillness and cruelty spoke in a monotonous tone.
"It was much bolder this time."
The entity of malice added. Its tone sounded quite... satisfied? It was as if it was impressed by the Entity.
The other three entities ignored it. The calming entity stared at the incomprehensible entity and questioned,
"Did you find anything?"
"I did not."
The incomprehensible entity answered calmly. There seemed to be no fluctuations in its tone despite giving a negative answer.
The calming entity flickered. It didn’t seem to like the answer, and it wasn’t alone.
"How come?"
The entity of balance questioned, its tone full of doubt and confusion.

"It was a movement on such a big scale. There is no way that Anomaly didn’t leave any clue behind. Did you try investigating the worlds that were destroyed? That Anomaly might be trying to target them for a reason."
"Yes, there was a reason."
The incomprehensible entity answered.
The other three entities waited for it to continue, and suddenly,
The table in the middle of the four entities turned black.
To normal people, it would be nothing different than a pitch-black screen. The four entities, however, were far from normal.
They could see it.
Billions of small dots that seemed invisible to the naked eye.
The black screen was the Universe,
The complete Universe.
Yes, the Universe was still expanding, and the surprising thing was that its expansion was being shown in real time on the screen.
Yes, it was a depiction of the real Universe, in real time.
The four entities had access to the entire thing, even the smallest corner of this vast Universe.
Of course, none of the four seemed surprised by it. The incomprehensible entity didn’t expect any reaction to it either.
Rather, the three entities waited, waiting for the incomprehensible entity to continue.
Suddenly, the black screen zoomed in, highlighting a certain area of the Universe that showed millions of worlds.
It was similar to what Nux showed his wives, but compared to that, it was much more... real.
Then suddenly, more than 300 ’dots’ that were now somewhat visible to the naked eye started shining, and a pattern was formed.
"A... smirk?"
The entity of balance spoke in a confused tone.
"The reason."
The incomprehensible entity answered, and the other three understood what it meant.
"A message."
The entity of stillness muttered.
"Heh, it is laughing at the Universe."
The entity of malice sounded like it was grinning widely.
It is laughing at us."
The entity of balance spoke, its tone grim.
"It should know that the Universe is merely a Will. It would never be able to interpret this message.
The only ones who would actually understand, or care to understand, are..."
"Us."
The incomprehensible entity completed those words, and in an instant, the giant room turned silent.
Even the entity of malice, who seemed to be grinning without stop and impressed by the Anomaly, had turned silent.
Every entity in this room, no matter, the entity filled with endless malice, or the entity filled with endless kindness,
They had one thing in common.
Arrogance.
Extreme arrogance.
Arrogance born from staying at the top from the beginning of time itself.
While every single one of them would entertain something amusing, something that would make them... feel something,
None of them liked to be challenged,
None of them... liked to be laughed at.
"What are you doing?"
The entity of malice questioned directly, its question directed at the incomprehensible entity.
"Why haven’t you found out who this bug is?"
"And how am I—"
"366 worlds have been destroyed, and you are telling me not a single one of them has a connection to the Anomaly?
Look into what these 366 worlds were involved in, their politics, their allies, their enemies, the factions they belonged to.
Look into everything separately.
That smirk is clearly a way to hide something.
Look into what I said, and you will find the Anomaly."
The entity of malice gave out a way.
Yes, it was a lot of work.
Looking into more than 300 destroyed worlds separately was a time-consuming task... for others, that is.

For the incomprehensible, it was something that could be done within a matter of minutes. Yes, these worlds are devoured by the very Universe, so they couldn’t revive anyone to know what happened, but investigating worlds around the destroyed worlds and rewriting their complete history through that wasn’t difficult.
But...
"We do not know what we are looking for."
The incomprehensible entity answered with a frown.
Silence fell over the room, and it continued,
"We have no lead on the Anomaly. We do not know what it looks like or what it even is.
It could be another Will or a living being. We cannot disregard anything.
The only connection we have with the Anomaly is that Crimson Mist man, but..."
"We do not know if that man even exists."
The entity of balance understood the problem.
"That is correct."
The incomprehensible entity answered.
"That man could be a ruse created by the Anomaly to divert our attention,
An illusion,
Or the Anomaly itself.
It can even be a faceless entity that showed itself to confuse us. Continue
Or...
It can be a man who presented himself as he was, without any fear."
Once again, the room turned silent.
"The history of all the destroyed worlds showed their own conflicts. They had nothing in common, nothing we could use.
It was all completely random.
Every world had its own story, own secrets, own... possible anomalies, but...
There is nothing concrete."
The incomprehensible entity spoke. It had already done what the entity of malice had suggested, but it couldn’t find anything.
"Then..."
The entity of malice spoke up after a momentary silence.
It then highlighted all the worlds shown on the screen below and,
"Let’s destroy the entire area."
It suggested.

sentences.text: Once again, inside that stupidly large room, four entities gathered on each side of the comically large table.
"It happened again."
The entity that stood in the middle of stillness and cruelty spoke in a monotonous tone.
"It was much bolder this time."
The entity of malice added.
Its tone sounded quite... satisfied?
It was as if it was impressed by the Entity.
The other three entities ignored it.
The calming entity stared at the incomprehensible entity and questioned,
"Did you find anything?"
"I did not."
The incomprehensible entity answered calmly.
There seemed to be no fluctuations in its tone despite giving a negative answer.
The calming entity flickered.
It didn’t seem to like the answer, and it wasn’t alone.
"How come?"
The entity of balance questioned, its tone full of doubt and confusion.
"It was a movement on such a big scale.
There is no way that Anomaly didn’t leave any clue behind.
Did you try investigating the worlds that were destroyed?
That Anomaly might be trying to target them for a reason."
"Yes, there was a reason."
The incomprehensible entity answered.
The other three entities waited for it to continue, and suddenly,
The table in the middle of the four entities turned black.
To normal people, it would be nothing different than a pitch-black screen.
The four entities, however, were far from normal.
They could see it.
Billions of small dots that seemed invisible to the naked eye.
The black screen was the Universe,
The complete Universe.
Yes, the Universe was still expanding, and the surprising thing was that its expansion was being shown in real time on the screen.
Yes, it was a depiction of the real Universe, in real time.
The four entities had access to the entire thing, even the smallest corner of this vast Universe.
Of course, none of the four seemed surprised by it.
The incomprehensible entity didn’t expect any reaction to it either.
Rather, the three entities waited, waiting for the incomprehensible entity to continue.
Suddenly, the black screen zoomed in, highlighting a certain area of the Universe that showed millions of worlds.
It was similar to what Nux showed his wives, but compared to that, it was much more... real.
Then suddenly, more than 300 ’dots’ that were now somewhat visible to the naked eye started shining, and a pattern was formed.
"A... smirk?"
The entity of balance spoke in a confused tone.
"The reason."
The incomprehensible entity answered, and the other three understood what it meant.
"A message."
The entity of stillness muttered.
"Heh, it is laughing at the Universe."
The entity of malice sounded like it was grinning widely.
It is laughing at us."
The entity of balance spoke, its tone grim.
"It should know that the Universe is merely a Will.
It would never be able to interpret this message.
The only ones who would actually understand, or care to understand, are..."
"Us."
The incomprehensible entity completed those words, and in an instant, the giant room turned silent.
Even the entity of malice, who seemed to be grinning without stop and impressed by the Anomaly, had turned silent.
Every entity in this room, no matter, the entity filled with endless malice, or the entity filled with endless kindness,
They had one thing in common.
Arrogance.
Extreme arrogance.
Arrogance born from staying at the top from the beginning of time itself.
While every single one of them would entertain something amusing, something that would make them... feel something,
None of them liked to be challenged,
None of them... liked to be laughed at.
"What are you doing?"
The entity of malice questioned directly, its question directed at the incomprehensible entity.
"Why haven’t you found out who this bug is?"
"And how am I—"
"366 worlds have been destroyed, and you are telling me not a single one of them has a connection to the Anomaly?
Look into what these 366 worlds were involved in, their politics, their allies, their enemies, the factions they belonged to.
Look into everything separately.
That smirk is clearly a way to hide something.
Look into what I said, and you will find the Anomaly."
The entity of malice gave out a way.
Yes, it was a lot of work.
Looking into more than 300 destroyed worlds separately was a time-consuming task... for others, that is.
For the incomprehensible, it was something that could be done within a matter of minutes.

Yes, these worlds are devoured by the very Universe, so they couldn’t revive anyone to know what happened, but investigating worlds around the destroyed worlds and rewriting their complete history through that wasn’t difficult.
But...
"We do not know what we are looking for."
The incomprehensible entity answered with a frown.
Silence fell over the room, and it continued,
"We have no lead on the Anomaly.
We do not know what it looks like or what it even is.
It could be another Will or a living being.
We cannot disregard anything.
The only connection we have with the Anomaly is that Crimson Mist man, but..."
"We do not know if that man even exists."
The entity of balance understood the problem.
"That is correct."
The incomprehensible entity answered.
"That man could be a ruse created by the Anomaly to divert our attention,
An illusion,
Or the Anomaly itself.
It can even be a faceless entity that showed itself to confuse us.
Continue
Or...
It can be a man who presented himself as he was, without any fear."
Once again, the room turned silent.
"The history of all the destroyed worlds showed their own conflicts.
They had nothing in common, nothing we could use.
It was all completely random.
Every world had its own story, own secrets, own... possible anomalies, but...
There is nothing concrete."
The incomprehensible entity spoke.
It had already done what the entity of malice had suggested, but it couldn’t find anything.
"Then..."
The entity of malice spoke up after a momentary silence.
It then highlighted all the worlds shown on the screen below and,
"Let’s destroy the entire area."
It suggested.

paragraphs: "Then..."
The Entity of Malice spoke up after a momentary silence.
It then highlighted all the worlds shown on the screen below and,
"Let’s destroy the entire area."
It suggested.
"Have you lost your mind?"
The Entity of Stillness questioned. From its tone, it was clear that it didn’t like the suggestion and was prepared to oppose it.
And it wasn’t alone.
"Without a reason?"
The Entity of Balance didn’t seem satisfied either.
"It is you who need a reason.
I do not."
The Entity of Malice replied.
"That Anomaly must have a reason to choose these 366 worlds. I find it hard to believe that it just chose these worlds because they formed a smirk.
There are billions of ways to form a similar smirk anywhere else in the Universe.
Then why this?
Why these specific 366 worlds?
There must be a reason.
An enmity, a political strife, or some other reason.
I am not saying it is all 366 worlds. It might be one of them or a group of them that is somehow related to the Anomaly.
It doesn’t matter.
The only thing that matters is that most of these worlds do not have a way to interact with worlds outside their sector.
So if they had a connection with the Anomaly, then the Anomaly must be from the worlds around them.
The Anomaly must be from..."
The millions of worlds shown on the table shined and,
"One of these worlds."
The Entity of Malice spoke, its voice full of malice and cruelty.
"All we need to do is take out these worlds, and the problem will be solved."
"And what if it doesn’t?"
The Incomprehensible Entity questioned directly.
"What if you are... wrong?
What if the Anomaly chose these 366 worlds without a reason?
What if these worlds just happened to be one of billions of ways to form a smirk the Anomaly chose?"
"The chances of that happening are one in a billion—"
"No. It is not.
Stop pushing your agenda. Do not think we do not know what you are planning."
The Entity of Stillness raised its voice.
It had had enough.
The rest of the entities were on its side as well.
Everyone here knew that the Entity of Malice thrived in negativity. Wars, massacres, and deaths increased its Authority, and if they went along with its plan,
It would become too strong,
Much stronger than the three of them.
And this was what the Entity of Malice was aiming for.
"Destroying millions of worlds just because you think the Anomaly might be related to one of those worlds? What kind of brutish suggestion is that?"
"And what if it is true?"
"And what if it is not?"
The Entity of Stillness countered.
"If it is not, then we stop the war."
The Entity of Malice offered.
Yes, it was an offer.
An offer that would benefit the Entity of Stillness a lot.

In contrast to the Entity of Malice, the Entity of Stillness’s Authority was reliant on positivity. If the war stopped, countless lives would be saved, and it would strengthen the Entity of Stillness to the point where it would be able to stand against the strengthened Entity of Malice.
Explore more at freewebnovel
The Entity of Stillness turned silent.
The Entity of Balance, however, frowned.
It couldn’t let the other two Entities get too strong; that would break the balance—its own Authority.
The Entity of Balance had no option but to turn towards the Incomprehensible Entity, the only Entity that didn’t need any Authority.
The Entity of Balance sought its alliance in order to stop the Entity of Malice and the Entity of Stillness, who seemed to have made a decision together.
"Do not be foolish."
The Incomprehensible Entity spoke up.
If the Entity of Malice and the Entity of Stillness got too strong, things would become complicated. It was the last thing the Incomprehensible Entity wanted.
However...
It couldn’t say it out loud.
Fortunately, it had an even stronger reason.
"If we cause such large-scale destruction, the Universe will react."
"What?"
"That makes no sense."
The two Entities of extreme opposites opposed at the same time, standing together.
"The Universe’s Will is on edge.
It has already caused a mass-scale destruction, and it was probably all for naught. If we cause another, even bigger-scale destruction, it might retaliate against us."
The Entities turned silent, unable to come up with a retort.
They treated the Universe’s Will like a moody child. With how angered it currently was, if they destroyed a part of it...
There would be retaliation indeed.
Retaliation they would have a difficult time surviving.
This was also the reason such large-scale destructions weren’t common.
Well, in most cases, before the Universe, it was the other Entities that stopped such destructions because of their own interests, but yes, the Universe’s reaction also couldn’t be ignored.
"Also."
The Incomprehensible Entity wasn’t done yet.
It needed to make sure the alliance between these two could not happen.
"How do we know you will stop the war once we destroy all these worlds?"
It questioned, and the Entity of Malice couldn’t reply.
"Or maybe, let’s stop the war first and then discuss the fate of these worlds. What do you say?"
The Incomprehensible Entity questioned. Everyone in the room could sense its smirk.
Yes, the Incomprehensible Entity didn’t care about Authority, so the order of these two events didn’t matter to it.
But...
To the Positive and Negative Entities, it did.
They couldn’t trust each other.
If the Entity of Malice got stronger first, there were chances it would go back on its word, and believe it or not, it was the same for the Entity of Stillness.
No one in this room could be trusted.
They all had ’faces underneath faces.’
In an instant, the room turned silent, every Entity thinking for its own sake.
It was amusing how all four of them forgot about the Anomaly.
Such was politics.
The Four Supreme Worlds could be the Supreme Entity that ruled over the Universe collectively, but...
That simply wasn’t possible, for in any world or Universe,
There could only be One Ruler.

chapters.title: Chapter 1905: A Law that the Very Universe resists.
paragraphs: "I feel like they are all ganging up on me..."
Nux complained as he glared at the other corner of the battlefield.
"Of course, they are."
Amaya, who was sitting next to him, spoke with a light smile on her face.
"It is not a group battle."
Nux complained.
"It is you, Vyriana, Aeliana, the Dragon Progenitors, and the Human Progenitors in a group battle where every being stands for himself.
It is obvious that they will try to take you out first."
Amaya answered.
"That makes no sense."
Nux shook his head as he placed his head on the devourer’s lap as if it was the most natural thing to do.
Amaya, obviously, quickly made him comfortable and started ruffling his hair. A wave of comfort washed over Nux as she did that.
"All of them know what sort of man you are, Nux."
The devourer chuckled as she stared at the battlefield ahead of her.

"You will never let anyone attack Vyriana, Aeliana, or Lady Faustina. Even if they do not want it, you will still defend them. With how Vyriana is, she would want you out so she can go all out without thinking about anything else.
Aeliana and Lady Faustina would stay back, but there will be tension between you three as well.
All of this would end the moment you are out. That’s what the two Dragon Progenitors want, and Lord Caesar simply joined them."
"Tsk tsk, shouldn’t my wives and mother defend me?"
Nux complained.
"She is not your wife yet."
Amaya narrowed her eyes. Soon, however, her jealousy turned into confusion.
"Why isn’t she your wife yet?
What’s holding you back?"
"She isn’t ready yet."
Nux answered with a light smile on his face as he glanced at the Vampire who was sitting at a corner together with Vyriana.
"What does that mean?"
Amaya frowned.
"She has... a lot of things in her mind right now."
"Is it about Lord Azriel?"
Amaya questioned.

"It is one of them. The matter of the Black Order dissolving and merging with the Ancestral Order, the complete inclusion of the Foxkins, the message from Sylveris, and the Faction that has now taken over this Sector.
There are too many things in her head, things that are holding her back.
Things that..."
"Might make her stay in Yrniel."
Amaya understood Nux’s line of thought and completed his sentence.
"And you do not want that."
"I will not leave any of my wives behind."
"This is why you are hesitating?"
"I am not hesitating, I am waiting. I need some... answers."

Nux spoke, his eyes shining meaningfully. Yes, just like Aeliana, Nux had a lot in his mind as well, and the last thing he wanted was to ruin their first time together because he couldn’t get it together.
Amaya stared at her husband for a moment and then,
"I need some answers too."
She started.
"Hmm? What is it? Is it related to your cultivation?"
"No, that is fine. I will break through soon."
"How confident."
Nux chuckled.
Amaya shrugged; it wasn’t a big deal.
The devourer then stared at Nux and,
"What I want to know is...
Why did you kill Vulpiana?"
Nux raised his eyebrow as he heard that question.
"Why ask this now? 10 years have passed, you know?"
"Just answer."
Amaya smiled.
"You loved her, you knew she loved you; then why did you kill her?"
"It wouldn’t have worked."
Nux shook his head.
"Nux, it is you.
She would have realized why you did what you did. Her mother was wrong; once she realized it, she would have for-"
"That’s not it."
Nux shook his head again.
"It wouldn’t have worked from my side."
Amaya narrowed her eyes at those words.
A small smile then appeared on Nux’s face and,
"She chose her mother, who had raised her and protected her from everything, over me, who came into her life barely a few centuries ago."
Amaya frowned.
"Amaya, I am an extremely spoiled man.
I am surrounded by women who have lost their minds. Women who couldn’t think of anything else but me."
Nux continued to look into Amaya’s eyes and,
"Women who look at me with possessiveness that overpowers anything else.
Women who would do anything for me.
Women who look into my eyes with desire so strong that it wouldn’t be surprising if they grabbed me, took me to a place no one can find me in, and never let me leave.
Women who would... choose me over anything else."
Nux’s eyes changed, showing intense, borderline craziness and...
The worst thing?
Amaya’s eyes reflected the same emotions, if not stronger.
Or maybe it was a good thing?
One couldn’t come up with an answer. It was a messy, unstable relationship that was in no way healthy, but...
For some strange, crazy reason, it worked out.
"You see, when a man is spoiled with all this, it is natural for him to become very selective. The moment Vulpiana held her mother’s hand,
She wasn’t the only one who had two choices ahead of her,
The same was true for me too.
I had to choose between the crazy women I loved too much and a woman who, yes, I loved, but... I wasn’t crazy over.
She willingly put my wives in danger."
Nux’s eyes narrowed down threateningly,
"There was no Universe where she could have gotten out of that alive."
Amaya turned silent at that answer. She just stared at her husband, her eyes reflecting extremely strong possessiveness.
Sniff Sniff
Nux frowned as his senses picked up a scent, and soon, a perverted smile appeared on his face.
"See? This is the sort of crazy I am dealing with. That fox was never cut out for it."
"I already said it before, husband.
No one, and I mean no one, but me is cut out for it.
Even those other bitches around you, they are all just there.
Only I am supposed to be your focus. Whatever you want, find it in me.
I am the only one you need."
Amaya spoke, her voice turning heavier and heavier as the crazy couple stared at each other almost foolishly.
Sinking deep into each other’s eyes, they got close, closed their eyes, and just as their lips were about to devour each other’s, a hand appeared in the middle, stopping the kiss.
Amaya’s eyes shot open as she glared at whoever had appeared.
It was Vyriana and Aeliana.
"What do you two want!?"
She shouted.
Vyriana, however, just looked down at the Devourer and,
"Break through first,
We will settle this with our fists."
She spoke.
"Bring it on, bitch."
Amaya declared war.
Vyriana just shrugged; she wasn’t scared either.
The Devourer then turned towards Aeliana and,
"And you, I will kill you too."
She threatened.
"Sure."
Aeliana just chuckled.
Her response was light; however, it worked perfectly in order to trigger the Devourer.
Clearly, the Vampire was looking down at her.
And Nux, who stared at this scene in silence, couldn’t help but smile like a fool.
This was exactly what he was talking about.
The Fox never stood a chance.
"Stand up, we need to train."
Vyriana called as she picked him up and took him away from the Devourer.
Amaya clenched her fists. If only she was a Primordial right now, she would have devoured both the Dragon and the Vampire.
In the end, the Devourer closed her eyes and allowed Shadow to pull her back into Nux’s Universe.
All of this could be done later; first, she needed to break through.

Time passed, Nux continued to train with all the others, and they continued to gang up on him. However, even after beings that strong were coming at him all at the same time, they couldn’t defeat him.

None of them could reach him. The moment Nux found himself in a difficult situation, he simply teleported away, and because his Law of Absolute Space was so absurdly strong, nothing could stop him from moving away.

If before, teleporting in the middle of a battle was difficult since he needed to think of the dimensions and too many things weakened the space barrier between the two spots, affecting the teleportation,
Now, his teleportation was Absolute.
If he decided to teleport to a place, then unless a Space Law stronger than his own was used to hinder his movement, it could never be hindered.
And who had a Law stronger than him?
No one.
Yes, no being in this Universe had a Space Law better than Nux’s because Nux had comprehended something no one was supposed to comprehend.
The Complete Law of Absolute Space was one of the Laws that was protected by the very Universe itself.
’The Universe resists the formation of strong Laws because it is a living entity as well.
Getting stronger and taking control over it?
What living entity would want to give away its freedom?
Just like any other being,
The Universe loves its freedom as well.
It would never allow the creation of something that can later become a threat to it.
Just take your wife’s Law, for example,
The Law of Absolute Devour.
Absolute Devour, the ability to devour anything that exists—this is what it should be, but...
Can it devour the very Universe itself?
It cannot.
The same is true for Laws related to creation; the Universe will never allow the creation of something threatening.
You can play with time and space all you want, but when it comes to harming the Universe, you will face a resistance so strong that you will feel like all your limbs are tied up.’
These were the words Azriel had said to him when his so-called father appeared and talked about how great the Law of Absolute Growth he had created was.

Yes, the Complete Law of Absolute Space was one of the Laws the Universe would never allow to be created. This was the reason it made it such that one was supposed to enter the Black Hole in order to comprehend it.
Something that no being could survive...
No one but Nux.

And with the Complete Law of Absolute Space in his arms, he was pretty much unstoppable since even Transcendents would have a difficult time keeping him in one place, let alone Progenitors, who didn’t even have a Law, let alone Domains.
What’s Worse?
Nux wasn’t even using this Law to its fullest extent yet.

Is it related to your cultivation?"
"No, that is fine.
I will break through soon."
"How confident."
Nux chuckled.
Amaya shrugged; it wasn’t a big deal.
The devourer then stared at Nux and,
"What I want to know is...
Why did you kill Vulpiana?"
Nux raised his eyebrow as he heard that question.
"Why ask this now?
10 years have passed, you know?"
"Just answer."
Amaya smiled.
"You loved her, you knew she loved you; then why did you kill her?"
"It wouldn’t have worked."
Nux shook his head.
"Nux, it is you.
She would have realized why you did what you did.
Her mother was wrong; once she realized it, she would have for-"
"That’s not it."
Nux shook his head again.
"It wouldn’t have worked from my side."
Amaya narrowed her eyes at those words.
A small smile then appeared on Nux’s face and,
"She chose her mother, who had raised her and protected her from everything, over me, who came into her life barely a few centuries ago."
Amaya frowned.
"Amaya, I am an extremely spoiled man.
I am surrounded by women who have lost their minds.
Women who couldn’t think of anything else but me."
Nux continued to look into Amaya’s eyes and,
"Women who look at me with possessiveness that overpowers anything else.
Women who would do anything for me.
Women who look into my eyes with desire so strong that it wouldn’t be surprising if they grabbed me, took me to a place no one can find me in, and never let me leave.
Women who would... choose me over anything else."
Nux’s eyes changed, showing intense, borderline craziness and...
The worst thing?
Amaya’s eyes reflected the same emotions, if not stronger.
Or maybe it was a good thing?
One couldn’t come up with an answer.
It was a messy, unstable relationship that was in no way healthy, but...
For some strange, crazy reason, it worked out.
"You see, when a man is spoiled with all this, it is natural for him to become very selective.
The moment Vulpiana held her mother’s hand,
She wasn’t the only one who had two choices ahead of her,
The same was true for me too.
I had to choose between the crazy women I loved too much and a woman who, yes, I loved, but...
I wasn’t crazy over.
She willingly put my wives in danger."
Nux’s eyes narrowed down threateningly,
"There was no Universe where she could have gotten out of that alive."
Amaya turned silent at that answer.
She just stared at her husband, her eyes reflecting extremely strong possessiveness.
Sniff Sniff
Nux frowned as his senses picked up a scent, and soon, a perverted smile appeared on his face.
"See?
This is the sort of crazy I am dealing with.
That fox was never cut out for it."
"I already said it before, husband.
No one, and I mean no one, but me is cut out for it.
Even those other bitches around you, they are all just there.
Only I am supposed to be your focus.
Whatever you want, find it in me.
I am the only one you need."
Amaya spoke, her voice turning heavier and heavier as the crazy couple stared at each other almost foolishly.
Sinking deep into each other’s eyes, they got close, closed their eyes, and just as their lips were about to devour each other’s, a hand appeared in the middle, stopping the kiss.
Amaya’s eyes shot open as she glared at whoever had appeared.
It was Vyriana and Aeliana.
"What do you two want!?"
She shouted.
Vyriana, however, just looked down at the Devourer and,
"Break through first,
We will settle this with our fists."
She spoke.
"Bring it on, bitch."
Amaya declared war.
Vyriana just shrugged; she wasn’t scared either.
The Devourer then turned towards Aeliana and,
"And you, I will kill you too."
She threatened.
"Sure."
Aeliana just chuckled.
Her response was light; however, it worked perfectly in order to trigger the Devourer.
Clearly, the Vampire was looking down at her.
And Nux, who stared at this scene in silence, couldn’t help but smile like a fool.
This was exactly what he was talking about.
The Fox never stood a chance.
"Stand up, we need to train."
Vyriana called as she picked him up and took him away from the Devourer.
Amaya clenched her fists.
If only she was a Primordial right now, she would have devoured both the Dragon and the Vampire.
In the end, the Devourer closed her eyes and allowed Shadow to pull her back into Nux’s Universe.
All of this could be done later; first, she needed to break through.
Time passed, Nux continued to train with all the others, and they continued to gang up on him.
However, even after beings that strong were coming at him all at the same time, they couldn’t defeat him.
None of them could reach him.
The moment Nux found himself in a difficult situation, he simply teleported away, and because his Law of Absolute Space was so absurdly strong, nothing could stop him from moving away.

If before, teleporting in the middle of a battle was difficult since he needed to think of the dimensions and too many things weakened the space barrier between the two spots, affecting the teleportation,
Now, his teleportation was Absolute.
If he decided to teleport to a place, then unless a Space Law stronger than his own was used to hinder his movement, it could never be hindered.
And who had a Law stronger than him?
No one.
Yes, no being in this Universe had a Space Law better than Nux’s because Nux had comprehended something no one was supposed to comprehend.
The Complete Law of Absolute Space was one of the Laws that was protected by the very Universe itself.
’The Universe resists the formation of strong Laws because it is a living entity as well.
Getting stronger and taking control over it?
What living entity would want to give away its freedom?
Just like any other being,
The Universe loves its freedom as well.
It would never allow the creation of something that can later become a threat to it.
Just take your wife’s Law, for example,
The Law of Absolute Devour.
Absolute Devour, the ability to devour anything that exists—this is what it should be, but...
Can it devour the very Universe itself?
It cannot.
The same is true for Laws related to creation; the Universe will never allow the creation of something threatening.
You can play with time and space all you want, but when it comes to harming the Universe, you will face a resistance so strong that you will feel like all your limbs are tied up.’
These were the words Azriel had said to him when his so-called father appeared and talked about how great the Law of Absolute Growth he had created was.
Yes, the Complete Law of Absolute Space was one of the Laws the Universe would never allow to be created.
This was the reason it made it such that one was supposed to enter the Black Hole in order to comprehend it.
Something that no being could survive...
No one but Nux.

And with the Complete Law of Absolute Space in his arms, he was pretty much unstoppable since even Transcendents would have a difficult time keeping him in one place, let alone Progenitors, who didn’t even have a Law, let alone Domains.
What’s Worse?
Nux wasn’t even using this Law to its fullest extent yet.

chapters.title: Chapter 1906: We didn’t lose.
paragraphs: ’Should I try it?’
Nux, who was being overwhelmed by the group of attackers, wondered in his mind. He had been delaying it since he wanted to test a few things on his own, but now...
At the very least, he wouldn’t be killing anyone here by mistake.
’Let’s do it.’
Nux decided as he stared at the six beings in front of him and,
Flicker
He disappeared and appeared a kilometer away from them. The instant the six of them sensed his presence, they turned around and dashed towards him,
But then,
Their surroundings changed.
The world around them cracked, the colorful surroundings had now turned pitch black with no light source whatsoever.
The only things visible here were the seven beings: Nux and the six others.
"What is this?"
Caesar, the Human Progenitor, frowned as he stepped in front of Faustina.
"Be careful."
Aeliana warned.
She had an idea of what was going on, but even she wasn’t clear.
"He is using the Law of Absolute Space."
Vyriana informed.
As someone who could sense Nux’s emotions, she realized what he was going to do the instant she sensed his curious and cautious emotions.
Yes, she was using the connection to her own advantage, not that Nux was complaining. Vyriana could feel how glad he was when she was using everything in her power to defeat him.
After all...
It was only fun to crush your opponents when they went all out.
"What careful!? A punch in the head will solve everything."
Dagahra, on the other hand, was a free spirit. He ignored everything around him and dashed towards Nux. His wife seemed to have the same line of thought as she followed him as well.
But...
No matter how fast they moved, the distance between them and Nux never closed.
"What is happening!?"
Dagahra shouted in annoyance.
"It is the space..."
Seraphina narrowed her eyes.
The space around them was stretched endlessly, making it impossible for them to get close to Nux unless...
Unless they teleported to him.
And that is what Aeliana did.
Sensing the energy she had put inside Nux a long time ago to keep an eye on all his movements, she activated an artifact to teleport right next to him.
But...
She was teleported to some random area, even further away from Nux.
It wasn’t just the Vampire; the Dragon and the Human Progenitors were the same. None of them could get close to Nux no matter what they did.
And then...
Nux formed hundreds of thousands of spatial spikes, prepared to rain down on them all at the same time.

Yes, it was all Faelara’s tactics, and in Nux’s hands, they were all absolute. Heck, he didn’t even need to create a separate dimension and lure the enemies there to use his full power. For him, the entire universe was his spatial dimension, where he could manipulate space as he desired.
Whoosh Whoosh Whoosh

The spatial spikes rained down on the six enemies, who tried to dodge them but failed miserably. Nux, on the other hand, simply sat down on the spatial throne he created and couldn’t help but be surprised.
"Holy fuck, this is absurd."
Yes, even he was surprised by how strong this Law was.
"No wonder that Fox was so confident..."
He had pretty much overpowered all six of them at the same time.
And his opponents weren’t just any weaklings either.
One of them was the strongest Primordial he knew.
One of them was on her way to becoming the strongest Primordial.
Find adventures on freewebnovel
While the other four were Pseudo-Transcendent Level beings who were stronger and faster than him and had greater defense.
To think he pretty much neutralized all six of them using just one Law...
And what’s worse?
It wasn’t just him who could have done that.
Faelara was very much capable of doing what she did as well.
Yes, if that woman somehow managed to bring all six of them to her dimension, and the Progenitors were restricted from using their Auras,
Faelara could have neutralized all six of them as well, just that...
Just like him, she would have no way to kill them using her spatial spikes, and while Nux himself never would, the Fox would have run out of energy and lost.
Well, that is, of course, if she decided not to run away, because if she did, none of these six could stop her.
Not to mention...
She also had the Black Hole...
While it still needed to absorb some large entities before it could be more effective, if Faelara was able to catch the six of them in the middle of those asteroids like she did with him,
They would have died, even the Progenitors.
Faelara Dawnshade was that strong.
The only reason she failed was because... she was facing a monster like Nux.
"How long are you going to keep this up?"
While Nux was thinking all this, Vyriana questioned with an annoyed look on her face.
Now, she didn’t even bother defending against the spatial spikes and let them hit her. Because of Nux’s quality of energy, they couldn’t do much damage to her anyway.
Yes, Nux’s biggest weakness still remained. Just like Faelara, while he could very much neutralize most of his enemies, even the stronger ones, using this Law, he couldn’t get rid of his enemies.
Because of his low quality of energy, his spatial spikes were even weaker than Faelara’s.
Of course, he did have the Black Hole as well, and unlike Faelara, he wasn’t weakened after summoning it once and could summon as many as he wanted at the same time.
If he did that,
All six of them would die, and it wouldn’t be a painless death either.
In the end, Nux had no choice but to wave his hand and stop the battle.
"I won."
He declared as everything returned to normal.
"We didn’t lose."
Dagahra didn’t want to admit defeat.
"Well, I would have completely defeated you if you had the ability to come back to life again, but you don’t.
So the only reason you ’didn’t lose’ was because you were weak.
Doubt that is something to be proud of."
Nux replied, and instantly, the Dragon Progenitor turned silent.

chapters.title: Chapter 1907: So he will be breaking through soon?
paragraphs: "Well, I would have completely defeated you if you had the ability to come back to life again, but you don’t.
So the only reason you ’didn’t lose’ was because you were weak.
Doubt that is something to be proud about."
Nux chuckled, and the Dragon Progenitor turned silent.
Faustina, on the other hand, smiled as she walked towards Nux and ruffled his hair.
"You grew up so quickly."
"Mother."
Nux smiled as he hugged his mother. Out of all six, the only person who wasn’t attacked by the Spatial Spikes was Faustina. Even if Nux knew he wouldn’t be able to hurt her, he just couldn’t attack.
"To think you were still holding back. I knew you would surpass me one day or the other, but...
I never thought that day would come so soon.
And to think you are still a Divine.
Please break through, child.
It is embarrassing for me."
Faustina chuckled.
Nux laughed out loud as well.
"I am trying. I really am."
Out of everyone here, Nux wanted to break through the most. After all, the enemies he would be facing would get stronger and stronger.
There was also that father of his who still hadn’t made a move yet.
The Supreme Worlds, who might already be after him.
And then the Universe, that would gladly use all its power if it ensured that he was dead.
Honestly, Nux was nowhere near strong enough to deal with any of his enemies, and it scared him.
What if... one of these enemies just appeared in front of him and his wives? What was he going to do?
Could he even run away?
What if they captured his wives to keep him there?
Would he be able to protect them?
There were too many questions in his mind that worried him, and every time, these questions seemed to chew his mind away.
’Oh, come on, we will be fine!
You only won because of that strange Law of yours! Fight me in a one-on-one battle of fists, and I’ll show you who you are dealing with!’
Vyriana snorted, talking to him using their connection as she sensed his feelings and understood what he was thinking about.
Nux just laughed at those words.
He moved away from Faustina as he then stared at Aeliana and Vyriana.
"You two aren’t hurt, are you?"
"You are doing this on purpose, aren’t you?"
The Dragon narrowed her eyes, and a playful glint appeared in Nux’s eyes.
"Nux, I am tell—"
However, before the Dragon could say or do anything, Nux stepped back and,
"Anyways, with this, our training is officially over. I need stronger opponents."
Yes, he was going to divert his mind by teasing his adorable wife.
"You—"
’Nux, I think it is time.’
Suddenly, Shadow called out.
’You think?’
’I believe you have decent control over it already.’
Shadow nodded, and Vyriana, who heard the conversation, nodded.
"I agree."
She nodded.
"You pretty much neutralized all six of us at the same time. What more could you need?"
"I just think this Law is even stronger. There is so much potential that I haven’t explored yet."
"Every Law has potential that hasn’t been explored.
Stop comparing it with Absolute Death. You have already explored that Law all the way to Eternal Level from Umbrasol’s memories.
You will never reach that level with this Law anytime soon."
Vyriana spoke, and Nux momentarily turned silent.
Maybe he really was pushing himself too far.
Honestly, he couldn’t be blamed either. Out of all the Laws he had comprehended, the Complete Law of Absolute Space was one of only two Laws he had comprehended on his own instead of stealing it.
So subconsciously, he was indeed comparing the two Laws, which, admittedly, was unfair.
"Alright then."
Nux nodded at Vyriana.
The Dragon nodded back.
"Shadow."
He spoke out loud as his shadow moved, pulling him into his Universe.
Silence fell over the place until finally,
"I sometimes have no clue what you two talk about."
Dagahra spoke out loud as he stared at Vyriana.
"You either talk in private using that connection of yours, or you talk out loud. Do not mix the two!
Why are you people so inconsiderate of others? Do you know how outcast Faustina feels whenever you do that?"
Faustina raised her eyebrow. She had no clue how she became the center of attention.
"Well, of course.
You don’t have to be so flustered; it is obvious that a parent would feel left out when their children keep secrets from them.
It is the same whether it is the son keeping secrets from his mother,"
Dagahra then momentarily glanced at Vyriana and,
"Or a daughter keeping secrets from her father."
"Oh, come on, stop acting out, old man. Don’t think I don’t know what you are trying to do."
Vyriana snorted as she then called out one of her sisters,
"Shadow."

As if waiting for it, Shadow pulled her in as well, and inside, Vyriana saw all the women connected to Nux’s Universe standing on one of the Stars, staring at Nux, who was hovering in the air, connected to his Universe,
Adding another Law into the Umbrasol’s environment and using the Very Space to stabilize the Balance he had forcefully stabilized before.
BOOOOM
The moment he did it, Shadow’s Aura burst out, instantly attracting everyone’s attention.
"How much stronger?"
Felberta questioned.
Shadow, however, was silent for a while.
"Shadow...?"
At her unusual reaction, Felberta called out, but then...
Shadow answered with a pause, staring at Nux in disbelief.
"What!?"
The others couldn’t believe it either.
He was just around Level 165 right now, how did...
"The Law he formed was too stable."
Shadow answered, and the women turned silent, amazed.
"So he will be breaking through soon?"
Amaya questioned.
"It shouldn’t take long.
It... might even happen right now."
Shadow nodded.
Then, her vision expanded as her eyes fell on around twenty shadowy beings, all that Nux had devoured all this time.
Stay connected via freewebnovel
And no, these weren’t incomplete entities that were just stuck in his Universe, no, all of them were in Umbrasol.
These were...
Complete Entities.
Entities Nux could reform, devour their cultivation, and... raise it again, making them break through the Divine Level,
Just like he did with Lyriana.
Entities through whom...
Nux could level up and...
Possibly Breakthrough.

Shadow, however, was silent for a while.

At her unusual reaction, Felberta called out, but then...

"What!?"
The others couldn’t believe it either.
He was just around Level 165 right now, how did...
"The Law he formed was too stable."
Shadow answered, and the women turned silent, amazed.
"So he will be breaking through soon?"
Amaya questioned.
"It shouldn’t take long.
It... might even happen right now."
Shadow nodded.
Then, her vision expanded as her eyes fell on around twenty shadowy beings, all that Nux had devoured all this time.

chapters.title: Chapter 1908: How about a role play?
paragraphs: "Shadow... what did you do to them...?"

Evane questioned as she stared at 18 entities that were similar to her. All of them were made of a black shadowy substance, but unlike the rest of the incomplete entities that seemed like blurry shadowy figures with next to no facial features, their features were clear, just like Nux’s wives.
They were Complete Entities, no different now than how they were before they got devoured.
Yet...
They seemed different.
They were... oddly silent?
No, it wasn’t silence. These beings had... no reaction at all.
Even when they were teleported here and were surrounded like this, instead of feeling any emotion like confusion, surprise, or anger...
They felt...
Nothing.
It was as if they were dead bodies.
Honestly, if it weren’t for Nux telling them they were very much alive, the women would have believed they were dead.
"W-Well... they were being annoying...
And none of you bothered to deal with them when they came here, so I had to do it."
Shadow replied, avoiding her sisters’ eyes.
"What did you do?"
Vyriana narrowed her eyes.
"She took away all their senses—their sight, smell, hearing, taste, touch, everything. Even their ability to perceive their Laws and connect with energy."
Nux answered.
Others may not be able to see it, but as the center of existence himself, he could.
"Without all these senses, they can only drift in endless dark space and... think.
I am sure almost every one of them must have convinced themselves that they have died and that it was the end of their life. That is also the reason you don’t see them moving.
They have given up.
Mentally broken, if you wish to put it in harsher words."
He explained, and the women turned toward Shadow, who, once again, continued to avoid their gaze.
"She... can do that?"
Lyriana was in disbelief.
"Well...
She is the Absolute Goddess of this place."
Nux shrugged, and at those words, Shadow lifted her ample breasts in pride, and Amaya could swear that the bitch was staring at her.
The Devourer’s mouth twitched. Shadow, on the other hand, turned toward Nux and,
"Should I return them to normal?
There will be a lot of questions.
I suggest you manipulate their memories with the new ability you got."
Yes, it was similar to before. Nux didn’t just go around devouring random beings. Yes, he now had more ’slots,’ but his thinking hadn’t changed.
If he was going to use one of his precious ’slots’ that he could have used to help people close to him, he would make sure he got something out of it.
The criteria were the same—a somewhat special, unique, or useful Law or abilities. And out of the seven beings he devoured, one of them had the ability to manipulate memories.
Yes, Nux could do so with the Slave Seal, but he couldn’t use the Slave Seal on everyone.
"Manipulate their memories, turn them into a clean state absolutely loyal to you, and we will have somewhat useful soldiers that the Main Universe cannot sense."
Shadow suggested.
Nux, however, shook his head.
As convenient as it sounded, there was one problem.
"If I manipulate their memories, they won’t be able to form their Laws."

Laws were complex concepts, hidden deep within one’s subconsciousness. Even if the memory manipulation he was doing was harmless from his side, in one way or another, it would affect the being’s comprehension and stop them from forming their Law again.
The worst part?
This process was irreversible.
Even if Nux undoes the manipulation he does, at the subconscious level, the being would never be the same again.
Shadow understood the problem and turned silent.
"So what do you want to do?"
She questioned.
"I have an idea."
Suddenly, a voice was heard.
Yes, it was the Devourer.
The woman glanced at Shadow with a little smirk that Shadow didn’t miss. Then, she turned toward Nux and,
"How about a role play?"
Hearing those words, Evane tilted her head in confusion.
"...Edda?"
"No, not that kind."
Amaya’s mouth twitched.
"Hmm? You have your own? Why didn’t I know that?"
Evane looked around, glancing at the rest of her sisters to see if she was the only one out of the loop.
"Well, who knows what this one does inside that Timeless Veil of hers."
Shadow shrugged with a grin.
"I’ll have you know, she is the most perverted out of all of us."
She spoke as she stared at the Devourer.
Amaya’s mouth twitched even more. She really wanted nothing more than to devour this bitch and end her existence.
The innocent Evane, however, failed to read between the lines for some reason and frowned,
"Why are you even discussing your fantasies right now?
We all have our own, and we should keep them priv—"
"I wasn’t talking about that.
Now shut up."
Amaya spoke, glaring at Evane.
The Queen turned silent. She, however, didn’t forget to stare at Nux and smirk ever so lightly.
Nux laughed inwardly, clearly knowing what the ’oh so innocent’ Evane was doing.
The Devourer, however, ignored everything around her and explained her plans.
Darkness.
An absolute void, where time had no meaning.
And in this void, an entity floated endlessly.
He didn’t know how long he had existed in this nothingness.
Seconds?
Hours?
Or... eternity?
He didn’t know, nor did it matter.
After all...
He was dead.
That Sovereign.
The Entity of Destruction that came to his world and destroyed everything.
He still remembered how his entire world quaked, how his World’s Will presented itself to that being, as if begging to be spared.
To a mere Sovereign.
No...
That was no Sovereign...
That was... an existence he still couldn’t comprehend. Explore new worlds at freewebnovel
As a Primordial, just his Aura alone should have brought that entity to his knees, but let alone bringing him to his knees, it seemed like his Aura didn’t even affect it.
It was then...
That entity released its own Aura, and in an instant, their world crumbled.
Everything he knew or understood was flipped over. He never thought destruction of that scale from one’s Aura alone was even possible.

The moment that entity released his Aura, every single being in his world either crumbled into the ground, dead... Even he, the strongest being of his world, could barely move as the endless weight crushed upon him.
It was as if the sky itself had collapsed.
There was no resistance.
It was the end.
An end he couldn’t forget, even when he had died. Even when he had been drifting in this dark, endless space, feeling...
Nothingness.
But then suddenly,
After a long, long time...
A sharp awareness jolted him awake from the numbness of death.

chapters.title: Chapter 1909: The Ruler of the Universe.
paragraphs: It was the End.
An End he couldn’t forget, even when he had died. Even when he had been drifting in this dark, endless space, feeling...
Nothingness.
But then suddenly,
After a long, long time,
A sharp awareness jolted him awake from the numbness of death.
It was only then that he realized that... he was moving.
No, he wasn’t waking, neither was he flying. He was... being dragged.
A force that seemed beyond his understanding had taken control over his body and was dragging him forward through the endless darkness.
He tried to fight it, but he couldn’t. He couldn’t even slow himself down. It was as though he was caught in a river, its current far beyond his ability to resist.
Then, he saw them.
Endless greyish figures—millions, maybe billions—moving in the same direction, all flowing along the unseen path like him. They were uniform, hollow, and... monotonous.
None of them turned their heads. None of them reacted to their surroundings. Just drifting endlessly, as if they couldn’t feel a thing or sense their surroundings.
But he...
He was different.
He could move his head.
He could think, observe, comprehend.
His body wasn’t grey like the others.
It was black.
A chill ran through his formless existence.
What is this place?
Is this... the afterlife?
Are those... souls?
Then why is my soul different?
Is it just from my perspective... or am I truly the only one like this?
All these questions filled his head but...
No answer came. Only the endless pull that continued to drag him forward.
Time passed.
Or maybe it didn’t.
There was no way to tell.
He didn’t know how long he waited... or did he wait at all...
The concept of time didn’t seem to exist in this place.
Then, something changed.
In the endless darkness ahead, it appeared.
A being—no, an entity—stood at the threshold.
Just like him, she had a black body, yet... she was different.
She released an authority so profound that even when he was dead, he could feel it pressing down upon him.
That entity...
She wasn’t just standing there...
She was... judging.
Or at least that is what it looked like.

An endless number of grey souls moved towards her, and one by one, the entity glanced at them—just a cold, uncaring glance—and then, she flicked her hand, sending the soul into one of the thousands of portals behind her, disappearing without resistance or question.
It was clear.
She controlled everything here.
As he drew closer, a familiar sensation built within him—dread.
It was similar to what he felt when that Sovereign had released his Aura and had crushed everything around him.
Finally, his turn arrived.
The beautiful entity turned her eyes toward him,
And for the first time, her expression changed.
On her monotonous, uncaring face, a different emotion appeared.
Surprise.
"Hm?"
In the endless, silent void, he finally heard a melodious voice.
The entity called out.
"You are conscious."
She could see it.
He, however, stayed silent.
The entity, however, didn’t seem to like his silence. She slightly narrowed her eyes and,
"Answer me."
She spoke, no, she ordered.
"I-I am."
His body seemed to move on its own. Even he had heard his own voice for the first time in who knows how long.
At his words, the woman’s frown deepened even further.
"Zala Fahrik."
She called out.
It was his name.
Unlike with other grey entities that she had just spared a single look before sending them to those portals, her gaze lingered on him much longer than normal.
It was as if she was trying to read his entire existence, trying to find a reason why he was... different.
It was then,
"You were chosen."
She spoke.
"W-What?"
"He chose you."
The woman answered, and at those words, Zala’s very existence seemed to shake as once again, the face of that monstrous entity appeared in his mind, his emotions agitated.
"W-What are you talking about? Who chose me? What is this place? Am I dead? Who are you? H-"
Read exclusive chapters at freewebnovel
"Calm down, Zala Fahrik."
The woman spoke. Her voice had such a powerful effect on him that all his agitated emotions were restrained.
"That ’entity’ who attacked your world, he chose you."
"What does that mean? Who was he?"
"He is the Ruler of the Universe, or... he once was before he was betrayed."
"Ruler of the... Universe...?"
Zala widened his eyes in disbelief.
"He is an entity you cannot comprehend."
The woman shook her head and...
For some reason, Zala couldn’t doubt her words.
It was as if the very truth of the Universe was being revealed to him, something he shouldn’t know, something... much grander than his entire existence.
"What do you mean when you said he was betrayed...?"
"Exactly what it means.
He was betrayed by the entities he created, entities he trusted, entities he... gave free will.
The Strongest Beings in the Universe."
"The Supreme Worlds...?"
Zala questioned.
As someone who was part of the ’Factions,’ he knew about the Supreme Worlds. The woman, however, laughed at those words.
"No, those lesser entities don’t even know of his existence yet."
"L-Lesser Entities...?"
Zala widened his eyes in horror.
The woman then looked into his eyes and,
"Zala Fahrik, forget the world as you know of it, for what you know is but a speck of dust."
Zala turned silent, intently listening to her words.
"What you need to understand is that the Ruler, who was once betrayed, has returned to claim what once belonged to him.
The Universe."
"What...?"
"He will rise to the top again, punish the traitors who betrayed him, and erase their existence.
In their stead, however, he will need new entities to take their role of overlooking the Universe, and you,
Zala Fahrik,
Are chosen as one of the contenders."
"I... I am chosen to overlook the Universe...?"
He had no clue what those words meant but...
"Are you willing to swear your absolute loyalty to the Ruler?"
"I am."
Zala nodded with a determined look on his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 1910: Are you blaming me?
paragraphs: "Are you willing to swear your absolute loyalty to the Ruler?"
"I am."
Zala nodded with a determined look on his face, and at his words, the woman smiled.
"Very well."
She spoke, and suddenly, a new portal, much different from many others, formed behind her.
"You will now be taken to the Ruler to rebuild your existence. You may think of it as a second chance to become something... more."
"Rebuild... my existence?"
Zala muttered, completely clueless as to what those words meant.
How could one rebuild one’s existence?
Your journey continues with freewebnovel
At his question, the woman stared at him, a slight frown appearing on her normally perfect face.
"Are you familiar with the term Law?"
She questioned, as if she was dealing with a toddler, trying to use vocabulary he would understand.
"I-I am."
"As a Middle Stage Mortal Veil Entity, or the Primordial Phase your people call it, you must have gathered enough experience in your life to understand yourself.
With all the experience you have gathered, the Ruler will allow you to form a new Law, something far stronger than what you had before.
That will be your foundation to rewrite your existence."
"I-I can reform my Law...?"
Zala widened his eyes in disbelief.
He didn’t know much, but what he did know was that one couldn’t reform his Law no matter how much he desired.
If one was stuck with a weak Law, he was destined for mediocrity for the rest of his life.
To be able to change that and allow someone to reform his Law...
It was unheard of.
He highly doubted even the Supreme Worlds had the resources to pull it off!
’No wonder she called them lesser entities...’
Zala finally realized what sort of beings he was dealing with.
"Yes, you can."
The woman nodded at his question. Then, as if the conversation here was done, his body started moving towards the newly formed portal.
"Wait! I have some more que—"
Zala tried to call out, but he quickly lost his voice. No matter how much he tried, no words came out of his mouth, and he was dragged into the portal while the woman continued to judge other souls.
On the other side of the portal, Zala finally saw him again.
That Sovereign who had destroyed his entire world with a mere release of his Aura.
’The Ruler...’
He thought inwardly, his face turning solemn.
Then suddenly, the Ruler turned towards him and...
He smiled.
"You are here."
He spoke, and in an instant, Zala’s body teleported next to him.
"So you chose to swear your loyalty. I didn’t think you would agree, considering how we met."
"...Why did you do it?"
Zala, who got his voice back, questioned.
"What do you mean?"
The Ruler tilted his head with a smile.
"Why did you destroy my world? If you wanted me, you could have easily taken me without having to involve my people in it."

He didn’t know where he got this courage from, but the instant the Ruler smiled at him, a sense of extreme comfort and warmth washed over him. It was as if he was standing in front of the universe’s most gentle and gracious being and could speak his mind here without having to worry about consequences.
"Are you blaming me?"
The Ruler questioned.
There was no change in his tone, even the smile on his face didn’t fade away. Everything seemed the same; he looked like the same gentle and gracious being as before.
But this time, Zala froze.
A primordial sense of fear took over him, a fear he had never felt before. His body trembled without stop, and he couldn’t utter any words.
It was a big change, almost as if his emotions were being affected by some foreign force as he stood in front of this being.
"Your world would have perished within three days."
The Ruler answered.

"You were about to lose the war because the enemy had been gathering reinforcements in secret. Most of you would have perished, while the remaining ones would have faced a fate worse than death. I simply preponed your fate and made it painless.
The reason I chose you is also your desperate attempt to fight back even when you knew the odds were stacked against you.
I liked that tenacity."
"But I didn’t..."
Zala tried to question back, once again feeling a strange sense of calm.
"You would have done it in the future."
The Ruler answered.
Yes, it was all bullshit.
But who cared?
Zala would never find out. There was no way to find out.
"You are saying that you chose me because of what I was going to do in the future...?"
"That is one way to put it."
Nux nodded.
"You... can see the future?"
Nux simply stared at him without any change in his expression. It was as if he was saying, ’Isn’t that obvious?’
Zala understood that look as well.
"You are like the Seer."
’The Seer, eh?’
Nux muttered inwardly.
He didn’t miss the familiar words.
The Seer was one of the most respected beings in the world. Almost everyone knew about her, but other than the Leaders of Supreme Worlds, no one had seen her—not even the Umbrasol Progenitors.
The Umbrasol Progenitors were extremely interested in the Seer. No, it wasn’t just them; everyone was.
The Seer is said to be omniscient.
She knows everything.
Everything.
None of her predictions had ever been wrong before. She knew even the deepest, darkest secrets one was hiding.

It is also said that if the Seer used what she knew to her advantage, she would gather a force even stronger than the Supreme Worlds’, and the very fact that she was alive and still relevant even when such rumors were spread was enough to tell what sort of existence she was.
Even the Supreme Worlds couldn’t harm her.
Or maybe... she was from one of the Supreme Worlds.
Nux, or the Umbrasol Progenitors, didn’t know.
That woman was a mystery.
A mystery no one had managed to solve.
For now, however, Nux couldn’t drop his act, so he smiled.
"Seer, huh?
Yes, you can compare me to that child in some regard."

Your journey continues with freewebnovel

With all the experience you have gathered, the Ruler will allow you to form a new Law, something far stronger than what you had before.

It was unheard of.
