chapters.title: Chapter 1921: Come with me.
paragraphs: "What about Aeliana?"
Vyriana questioned, and Nux froze.
"...I’ll talk to her first."
He replied after a short pause.
"What if she says no?"
Vyriana, however, didn’t let it go.
She could sense Nux’s chaotic emotions.
Nux didn’t answer, his body, however, continued to tremble. He couldn’t antagonize the Seer right now because that woman held power over his and his wives’ lives.
But...
What if Aeliana wanted the strange woman to stay away from her father?
What would he do then?
What would he do when he would need to choose between Aeliana and his wives?
"I’ll go talk to her."
Nux answered.
"Nux, you didn’t answer m-"
Before Vyriana could say anything, Nux disappeared.

The Dragon, sensing his emotions, panicked a little. The last thing she wanted right now was for her friend’s heart to break into pieces. The Vampire had barely started smiling now. If Nux did what she thought he was going to do, she would go back to how she was before.
No, maybe this time, it would be even worse.
’No.’
Vyriana shook her head and decided to follow Nux, but before she could, Felberta appeared next to her and grabbed her hand.
The Dragon turned towards the Eldraeth Progenitor and narrowed her eyes.
"Unhand me."
"You know he will do the right thing."
Felberta answered.
"I said unhand me."
"I cannot."
Vyriana stared at Felberta, the Eldraeth, however, wasn’t intimidated.
"You know what he is going to do. You sensed his emotions too. It will break Aeliana’s heart."
"He won’t do it. He is incapable of breaking his wives’ hearts."
"That’s the problem, Aeliana still isn’t one of us yet!"
Vyriana snapped, forcefully freeing herself.
She tried to leave, Shadow, however, restricted her from doing so.
"Yo-"
"Aeliana IS one of us."
Felberta answered.
"Nux doesn’t think that way, and you sensed it too!"
"Trust me, I would know."
Felberta answered calmly.
"He will not do anything that would break her heart."
"What makes you so sure...?"
The Dragon questioned as she narrowed her eyes, and at that question, Felberta just smiled.
"Well, I am the first for a reason."
Then, the Eldraeth Progenitor pointed at the screen that shared Nux’s vision with them.
He was already standing in front of Aeliana.
"Aeliana..."
He called out, his voice much lower than usual.
"Nux? What’s wrong?"
Aeliana, sensing something wrong with him, quickly rushed towards him with a worried look on her face.
"Did something happen? Is everything alright? Are you alright? What about the others? Are they alright?"
The woman asked a series of questions as she held Nux’s shoulders and stared into his eyes, almost as if she was trying to see through him.
Nux stuttered, overwhelmed by Aeliana’s questions. For the first time in such a long while, he felt this feeling of helplessness.
"Nux, what is it?"
Aeliana pressured him to answer, and for a moment, Nux expanded his senses, trying to sense where the Seer was.
She wasn’t here.
After his conversation with the Seer, the woman had disappeared, as if her aim here was fulfilled, and Nux didn’t know how to feel about it.
For now, however, he had more important things to worry about.
"I met the Seer."
He answered.
"The Seer...?"
Aeliana frowned.

She had heard the name from Nux before, but she didn’t know much about her. Nux started explaining who she was, everything she said, her wish to meet Azriel, Nux’s own doubt, and how he was worried about his father-in-law, his wives, and... Aeliana.
He shared it all, pouring his heart out.
In front of Aeliana, he couldn’t help but be completely honest. It was as if some force deep inside his body was stopping him from hiding or deceiving this woman.
Aeliana, who calmly heard everything he said, processed everything he said, and in a low tone, she asked a question,
"So you came to me because... you wish to wake Father up and tell him about her...?"
At that question, Nux’s body trembled as he turned silent.
The first response that came to his mind was a yes. For his wives’ safety, he had no other choice but...
Those words couldn’t come out of his mouth the moment he glanced at Aeliana.
Another, new line of self-destructing thoughts filled his head, thoughts that only come up when only his wives are involved.
"See? I told you.
In his heart, he already sees Aeliana as his wife. He will never hurt her."
Felberta, who was watching this from Nux’s Universe, smiled confidently, and Vyriana and the others, especially Amaya, stared at the woman in awe and surprise.
"How did you know?"
Amaya couldn’t hold back.
She was supposed to know Nux the most. Even the Seer said so. Then how did... Felberta know what she didn’t...?
Just like Vyriana, she could clearly sense Nux’s emotions, and it told her what decision he was going to make. How did that decision change so quickly? And how did she predict it?
At her question, Felberta just smiled gently and,
"You may know about him, his mind, and his emotions more than I do because of all your craziness."
The Eldraeth then pointed at her chest and,
"His heart, however, is all mine. I understand his heart better than he does.
After all, I was the first to settle in there."
Felberta chuckled, and Amaya’s mouth twitched.
Why did it feel like this woman was teasing her, but at the same time, she wasn’t?
What’s with this air of supremacy around her that she couldn’t seem to hide?
"I change my words. If I had the ability to go back in the past, I would have met Nux before you."
Amaya declared as she pointed at Felberta. The Eldraeth, however, just chuckled.
"Sure, that might give you a fighting chance.
Because you don’t have any now."
"Come with me."
While the women were having a discussion of their own, Nux spoke up.
He had finally made a decision.
A decision he didn’t know the consequence of.
"Where are we going?"
Aeliana questioned.
"To Umbrasol."

chapters.title: Chapter 1922: Your plan would annihilate Yrniel.
paragraphs: "Come with me."
Nux spoke with a determined look on his face.
"Where are we going?"
Aeliana questioned.
"To Umbrasol."
"What...?"
Aeliana blinked in surprise.
Umbrasol?
There was only one reason Nux would take her there—
"I am going to devour you and the others and prepare for the Seer coming after us. From what I know, she cannot enter our Universe, so as long as we all hide in there, we will be safe."
"What are you talking about? You know you cannot do that."
Aeliana frowned.
It wasn’t just her; the rest of the women who heard Nux’s words were taken aback as well. After all, they knew he was dead serious.
But...
If they followed through with this plan, then the moment the Reaper’s Veil disappeared and the Universe realized that the Leanders had disappeared again, it would attack Yrniel.
This was what had been stopping Nux from doing all this.

"I’ll use all the slots I have gathered. I’ll devour you and the others, and everyone that is close to us—the Progenitors, the Lust Family, the Bloodhearts, the Skys, Royce and his family, the Felines, the Frostwillows, and everyone I can—until all the slots run out.
We will cut short the losses as much as we can.
I’ll also break through to the Primordial Stage, which will allow me to turn everyone I devour into immortals with Absolute Laws.

This way, we will not only have an army, but since my Universe’s Cultivation Bridge allows its people to grow independently and reach the Eternal Stage, we will hide inside my Universe until everyone in the fighting force is on that level.

This will give us a fighting chance when we go against the Seer. The only problem is that she will not come alone—she will inform the Supreme Worlds, and with them working together, winning... might not be possible."

Nux’s expression turned grim. In his mind, he had already started imagining different scenarios where he would face the Seer and the Supreme Worlds together. He even thought about devouring Azriel and freeing him from Yrniel’s bounds. However, he wasn’t sure if his Universe was strong enough to support a monster like Azriel.
"Nux."
"NUX!"
Aeliana, who had been calling Nux for a while now, shook his entire body and raised her head.
Nux, who had pretty much lost his mind as he tried to come up with a plan, finally came out of his reverie and stared at Aeliana with a lost look on his face.
"Your plan would annihilate Yrniel."
"But I will be able to protect everyone. I will be able to protect yo—"
Nux was about to answer, but suddenly,
Aeliana leaned forward and sealed his lips.
Nux froze.
In an instant, all his messy, uncoordinated thoughts slowed down, and his bubbled-up emotions burst out.
His most primordial urge took over, his canines elongated, and then—
Pierce
He bit Aeliana’s lips and started sucking her blood.
"Mnnnhhhh~~"

The Vampire moaned, her back arched up as she leaned forward, trying to get even closer to Nux. The two of them slipped, with Aeliana falling on top of Nux. The Vampire, however, didn’t seem to care; she just—
Pierce
She pierced Nux’s lips as well, drinking his blood that numbed her mind like some sort of extremely strong intoxicant.
Thud

The two fell down, but they didn’t care. They continued to savor each other’s flavor while they continued to push their bodies toward each other. Nux’s hands moved, groping and feeling every part of Aeliana’s body.
The Vampire didn’t resist. She was too busy drinking Nux’s blood to think of anything else. There was no shame, no hesitation, and no delay in their movements.
The carnal Lust had taken over their minds.
"Mmnnnhhh~~"
Aeliana moaned again, her bloodied mouth continued to kiss Nux’s face—his forehead, his nose, his cheeks, his lips, his chin. She had painted his entire face with her blood.
The Vampire was marking her territory, and Nux... he allowed her to mark him as much as she wanted.
This was it.
There were no more questions or doubts about it.
She was Aeliana Leander. She was his.
And if he had to, he, together with her, was prepared to face the Seer and the Supreme Worlds, even if that meant all of them dying in the battle.
After all, they would all be together.
Even in death.
As Nux’s thoughts cleared up, he noticed something.
Yrniel...
Every being on Yrniel had passed out again.
He frowned as he expanded his senses. Then suddenly, his eyes widened.
"Lord Azriel..."
He called out.
"What?"
Aeliana, who was busy drinking Nux’s blood from his neck, froze when she heard her father’s name and glanced at her husband with a frown.
"He’s awake."
"What?"
"Your father, he is awake."
Nux answered, and in an instant, Aeliana distanced herself from Nux, her face turning red.
"W-Why is he awake!?"
She questioned as she quickly cleaned herself. Nux did the same as he then stared at the space in front of him.
Crack
The space cracked.
Yes, Azriel Ruinous was here.
"F-Father! W-What brings you here?"
Aeliana questioned. The Pseudo Leader of the Ancestral Order had instantly turned into a teenage daughter, trying to hide what she was doing from her father, and...
She was doing a very bad job at it.
Azriel, however, ignored his daughter and stared at Nux with an annoyed look on his face.
"You just couldn’t keep your hands off my daughter, could you?"
The man snorted.
"Is that the reason you woke up? Were you keeping an eye on your daughter?"
Nux narrowed his eyes.
"F-Father...?"
Aeliana stuttered, her face even more flushed now.
She was embarrassed!
"What? I worry about you. I just sensed a big spike in your emotions, and it woke me up. I thought you were in trouble."
"Shouldn’t you have gone back to sleep when you noticed she was fine?"
Nux questioned, and Azriel’s mouth twitched.
"I came here because I wanted to see how you were doing. I thought since I was awake anyway, I might as well meet you. Yrniel can support my existence for two minutes."
"Father-in-law, please come up with a better lie."
Nux answered with a deadpan look on his face.
Obviously, he didn’t believe this man for a second.
He came here to ruin the moment. He was sure of it!
"Father."
Suddenly, Aeliana called out.
"Hmm?"
"Have you heard about the Seer?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1923: She is my Aeliana.
paragraphs: "Father."
"Hmm?"
"Have you heard about the Seer?"
Aeliana questioned, and Azriel’s expression changed.
"Where did you hear that name?"
Aeliana simply stared at Nux, who shook his head without any change in his expression.
He would not do it.

He didn’t know what the Seer wanted from his father-in-law, but for Aeliana’s sake, he believed it was better that the two did not meet, even if it meant them having to go against the Seer and the Supreme World.
Aeliana, however, had a different line of thought.
"Nux met her."
She revealed, and in an instant, Azriel’s expression changed as he turned towards Nux.
"You... met the Seer?"
Nux didn’t know what to say.
"Nux, let my father decide what he wants. We do not make his decisions."
Aeliana then looked at Azriel, and a small, almost untraceable pout appeared on her face.
"Usually, he is the one who does that."
Clearly, the Vampire didn’t like how her time with her husband was interrupted just because her father was not prepared for it.
Azriel, who knew what his daughter was thinking about, wanted to come up with a counter. He, however, had nothing to say.

Yes, he came here because he wasn’t mentally ready to see his daughter grow, even if she was a being with absolute power. But for the father in him, she was still an innocent little girl who should only stay in his arms. And yes, Azriel was ashamed of his actions.
Therefore, he decided to change the topic, and conveniently, there was a perfect topic right in front of him.
"What does that mean? You brat, what are you not telling me?"
He narrowed his eyes as he stared at the man who wanted to steal his daughter from him.
Nux thought about it for a moment before he finally gave in.
Aeliana was right.
The being in front of him was the strongest being in all existence. Even someone like the Seer treaded carefully around him. He would know what is best for him and what is not.
"The Seer wishes to meet you."
"What...?"
Azriel raised his eyebrow. Nux nodded again, and Aeliana did the same.
"Are you sure she is the Seer? You aren’t being fooled, are you?"
"I do not know."
Nux shook his head.
"Hah?"
Azriel frowned. Clearly, the old man was judging his son-in-law, something Nux didn’t fail to notice.
"Even the existence of the Seer itself is sometimes considered a myth.
How am I supposed to know if she is real?"
Nux tried to defend himself, but—
"From the fact that she neutralized a Transcendent like it was nothing, snuck into a High-Level World without alerting anyone, and last but most importantly, she knew that you were a Universe."
Aeliana didn’t hold back.
"W-Well... those things could still be faked... can’t they...?"
Nux’s voice died down on its own by the end of his sentence, realizing how foolish it was.
’What in the hell is happening to me?’
He shook his head. Ever since he met the Seer, he had been thinking about too many absurd possibilities and was losing sight of what was more important.
It was as if something had gotten into his head and it was slowing down.
"You need to calm down, Nux."
Aeliana spoke as she tightly held Nux’s hand. Nux looked into his wife’s eyes and nodded. The two smiled at each other, losing themselves in each other’s eyes.
But...
Azriel, who heard Aeliana’s words, couldn’t believe them.
"What did you say? She knew he was a Universe?"
He questioned, attracting the couple’s attention.
"She did."
Nux nodded with a solemn look on his face.
"She told you that?"
"She also told me the Supreme World requested her to find me."
"And you still thought she is not the real Seer?"
Nux had no way to defend himself.
"Why did she come to you?"
Azriel questioned.
"I tried luring her out when I sensed her, bu-"
"You sensed her? The Seer?"
Azriel raised his eyebrow.
"I did. After I comprehended the Law of Absolute Space."
"Absolute Space...?"
"Uhhh...
You are completely out of the loop, huh?
Alright, I’ll start from the beginning."

Since Nux couldn’t exactly have a conversation with Azriel since they were running out of time, using Felberta’s Power of Genesis and his own Power over memories, he created a white orb and gave it to Azriel.
The orb contained everything that happened after he went to sleep. The Vampire Progenitor absorbed the orb within a second, and the next moment, he narrowed his eyes.
"What gives a weakling like you the right to worry about me?"
"I was worried about my Aeliana, not you."
"She is my Aeliana."
"You gave her to me, old man. Is your mind getting hazy with age? Do you need another memory orb? I have more than a few copies of those."
Azriel’s mouth twitched.
In the end, he decided it was better not to talk about it right now and jumped to the main topic.
"I wish to meet her."
"Are you sur-"
"Oh, come on. Why do I feel like you have become even more unbearably arrogant than the last time I saw you? Just when I was starting to like you too."
Azriel snorted.
Nux tried to defend himself. His father-in-law, however, was here to set him straight.
"I saw your memories. I saw every possibility you considered, so don’t try talking back to me."
Nux turned silent.
"After Umbrasol, your mind had developed and had reached a level others around you can never hope to reach.
You thought through things much more efficiently than others. You even saw possibilities others failed to consider, and you did all that at a scarily fast pace.
Because of that, you matured, your thoughts matured, and with the knowledge you absorbed, you did, you became better.
But now...
That enhanced brain of yours has become a weakness."
Nux narrowed his eyes at those words.

chapters.title: Chapter 1924: I’ll leave my body to you, Husband.
paragraphs: "But now...
That enhanced brain of yours has become a weakness."
Nux narrowed his eyes at those words.

"You have gotten too used to knowing everything and being able to predict everything around you, whether it was the Universe’s reaction to your movements or even that Fox’s possible betrayal. Somewhere in your mind, you knew about it all.
But the moment you encountered a being you couldn’t understand, your mind went off. Instantly, you started creating millions of possible scenarios about a being you didn’t understand.
Your mind drifted off, and you couldn’t think straight anymore, all because you couldn’t understand Seer’s existence like you normally do with others."
Nux turned silent.
"And did you actually believe that woman could harm me? Why do you think she approached you first instead of coming right to me?
Or better yet, if she had the ability to enter a world without alerting the World’s Will, why was she observing you from outer space instead of coming here to get a closer look?"
Nux’s expression changed at those words.
"She is... intimidated by you?"

"She is being careful around me, but maybe it is not intimidation. Maybe it is a form of respect. Maybe she is not the enemy you make her out to be? Maybe she wasn’t lying. Maybe she is actually trying to help you out?
Sure, there is a possibility of her being one, but trying to deduce that with the information you had on her was utter foolishness."
Again, Nux remained silent, something Azriel nodded at.
"Calm your mind. Stop thinking about all this. Spend time with those wives of yours."
The Vampire Progenitor snorted, indirectly telling Nux to go away with his daughter. Nux, however, frowned.
"What are you going to do?"
"Meet that woman, of course."
Azriel answered.
"How will you meet her?"
"She is the one who wishes to meet me, isn’t she? She will come to me on her own."
"So... you aren’t going back to sleep?"
Nux questioned.
"I’ll go to sleep after I meet her. I am sure her power can help hold off Yrniel until our conversation. Now leave."
Azriel spoke as he waved his hand and teleported Nux and Aeliana away.
’What...?’
Nux couldn’t believe what just happened.
’He teleported me...?’

With the Complete Law of Absolute Space, he had complete control over the space around him. Other spatial abilities shouldn’t work on him unless the one using these abilities had a Space Law stronger than his...
And Nux was absolutely sure Azriel didn’t have anything like that, considering the crude way he used to teleport from one space to another.
Then how did he...
Nux tried to think about it, then suddenly, a small smile appeared on his face.
’I am doing it again, huh...’
Acting strongly to things he didn’t understand.
’I need to stop.’
Nux shook his head.
Suddenly, Nux heard a voice.
A voice that sent shivers all over his body.
It was Aeliana, who was now looking at him with eyes that he couldn’t ignore no matter what.
The Vampire held his hands as she got close. Nux allowed her to do anything she wanted, and that was exactly what the Vampire did.

She got close. Her lips were now dangerously close to his. His breathing became louder, but just as Nux closed his eyes, expecting a soft, mouth-watering kiss, Aeliana’s lips moved away to his ears, and she whispered,
"That ability you used to show Father your memories—use it on me too."
"What...?"
Nux frowned.
"I want to see your memories."
"Your brain wouldn’t be able to handle all my memories."
Nux shook his head.
"The Illusion.
I want to see your memories of the illusion.
The way you looked at me changed when you came out of the illusion.
Something happened in the illusion that affected you so much that you were even prepared to stand against the strongest being in the Universe for my sake.
Something happened in there that told you everything about me, so much that you understood me better than I did.
I want to know.
I want to see what that something was.
I want to know what happened inside the illusion."
Aeliana whispered, her voice almost hypnotic, something he couldn’t resist.
But then, he smiled.
"I have something even better for you."
"What...?"
Aeliana stared at Nux in confusion.
"What do you mean?"
Nux’s smile widened as he once again used the Energy of Genesis and memory magic to create a Translucent Orb. As he did that, he stared at Aeliana and,
"I wanted to share this with you after you became my wife, but..."
Suddenly, Nux pulled the Vampire close to him, kneading her butt in a way that made her entire body tremble. Then, he brought his lips close to her ears and,
"You are already my wife, aren’t you, Aeliana Leander?"
"Took you long enough."
Aeliana smiled as she allowed herself to fall on Nux’s body.
Nux held her gently as if she were the most precious thing in the world. He enjoyed her unbearably soft body on top of him. His hand moved around her entire body, feeling every single inch of it.
The Orb he created hovered in the air, right in front of Aeliana’s eyes.
"What is it?"
She questioned, her eyes never leaving it.
"It is what you wanted.
Memories of what happened inside the illusion, but not mine."
"Not yours?"
Aeliana frowned. Soon, however, her expression changed, and sensing how her heart skipped a beat, Nux’s smile widened.
"These are your memories."
He revealed, and with a big smile on his face, he questioned,
"Would you like to see them?"
"I would."
Aeliana nodded.
"Then I will make sure your body is comfortable as you do."
"I’ll leave my body to you, Husband."
Aeliana smiled as she closed her eyes, and the orb hovering in front of her moved into her forehead, playing foreign memories—or rather, the memories of her own self.
Nux smiled at her words, and as he sensed that the Vampire was lost deep in her consciousness, he summoned a bed and allowed his body to fall—with Aeliana in his arms, of course.
Yes, it was about time.

Asking me out of the blue is no different than telling me to choose from millions of different possibilities and hope to be right, something I do not like to take my chances in because..."
"Because?"
"Because I am used to being right."

"You cannot blame me, no one likes to lose. For me, not being right is losing."

She was here now, wasn’t she?
Why didn’t she come before?
Why now?

"Well, this is one question I was hoping you wouldn’t ask."
The Seer chuckled.
"But you knew I would."
"The chances were high, yes."
She nodded.
"Then answer."
"I just... didn’t wish to meet you back then."
She answered in a strange tone, as if she was hiding something.

"What do you know?"

"I had these thoughts for a long time now."
He explained himself.
"We both know you are getting more and more desperate, Lord Azriel. I had to appear. Normally, I wouldn’t have cared about it, but your actions would hurt Nux, and I cannot allow that."
The Seer spoke. For some reason, her tone became much braver than before.
Azriel narrowed his eyes.
"How are my actions going to affect him?"
"Lord Azriel, do you truly believe your death will not affect him?"
The Seer questioned directly.
"You are the only being he ever respected or will ever respect. Not to mention there is Aeliana too. You think he wouldn’t be affected if he saw her devastated face?
You think...
...he wouldn’t do something he shouldn’t do?"
Azriel turned silent.
There were many questions in his head but...
The one that bothered him the most was...
"Are you saying that I will die?"

Azriel ordered as he sent Nux and Aeliana away with a wave of his hand.

THUNDER THUNDER THUNDER

’Alright, little guy.’

Everyone but Azriel.

The Seer.

"Yes."

chapters.title: Chapter 1929: There is no way for you to become even stronger.
paragraphs: "Are you saying that I will die?"
Azriel questioned directly as he narrowed his eyes.
"You should already know that, no?
This is the reason you wanted to meet me in the first place, isn’t it?
Trying to come up with a way to ensure your survival.
You wouldn’t have thought about it if you knew you were going to survive.
Deep inside, you already knew it would only result in your death."
Azriel turned silent.
Yes, the Seer was correct.
He knew he might die. No, "might" was a weak word. He knew he would die. His chances of survival were extremely low, if there were any.
Azriel knew it from the very beginning.
But...
He was desperate.
He was restricted. He couldn’t move. Heck, let alone moving, he couldn’t even stay awake, else the world he was in would perish.
He was stuck.
And while at first, it didn’t matter much since his daughter was in safe hands and his wives were already dead, he had no will to stay awake in the first place.
Yes, as much as he wanted to raise his daughter on his own, if that simply wasn’t possible, there was nothing he could do.
And he had to protect his daughter and his world too, didn’t he?
He couldn’t risk his life doing something that he knew would result in his death and put his world and daughter at risk.
Or...
At least, that was how he convinced himself to stay asleep.
But then...
That man appeared, the Chaos Progenitor, revealing a way to become God.
An Absolute Being with Absolute Control over everything, even Life and Death.
It was a chance,
A chance to revive his wives, and that stuck with him.
The more he thought about it, the more he wanted it, but...
The problem was the same.
He was stuck.
And once again, a thought that he had forcefully buried deep in his mind resurfaced.

Currently, Azriel was the strongest being in the Universe. Yes, even though he had never tested his strength against those Infinities from the Supreme Worlds, he had sensed their strength more than once.
Even when he protected Nux from them when he devoured his first world, he was able to sense their strength, and while it would take some effort,
Azriel knew he could get rid of them at the same time.
Of course, if they all came at him at the same time, things might get difficult. The battle might continue for a few days before he finally came out as the sole victor, but...
That was more than enough time for them to destroy Yrniel.
And...
Once Yrniel was destroyed, he, who was connected to it, would perish as well.

So technically, in a battle against those Infinities, the moment they found out that almost all his Blood Essence was formed by Yrniel and was connected to it, which they very quickly would, they would target Yrniel and...
Azriel would lose.
While his connection to Yrniel was the reason he could do so many things and even stay alive till this point, right now, it had become Azriel’s biggest weakness.
It was not only his lifeline but also restricted him from going out into the vast Universe and somehow finding a solution to this problem.
Was there a solution to this?

Azriel could form a connection to another World and return Yrniel’s Essence, freeing himself. This would not only make Yrniel unbearably stronger, allowing it to actually act like an incarnation of a Supreme World as it was, but it would also return Azriel’s ability to move and act independently.

Of course, his life would still be connected to the new world, but at the very least, he wouldn’t have to care about a Mana Apocalypse in that world and could freely roam around the Universe, trying to find a better solution to the problem.
At the very least, this was the first step he could take, and it would solve most of Yrniel’s problems...
But...
This wasn’t possible either.
Only five worlds in the entire Universe were strong enough to maintain Azriel’s existence without collapsing:
Yrniel and...
The other four Supreme Worlds.
Yes, Azriel had to forcefully take over a Supreme World for this to be possible. It was absurd.
In the end, the Vampire could only give up and change his line of thought.
Then, he came up with an idea the Seer was warning him about.
Forcefully ending his connection with Yrniel and trying to exist with whatever Blood Essence he was left with.
Yes, an absurd thought.
Something that would most definitely kill him, but...
What if...
What if he survived?
Azriel was relying on that little "what if."
And while before, he quickly abandoned those thoughts because he had a daughter to protect, now...
Someone else was protecting his daughter.
And as much as Azriel hated to admit it, he knew in his heart that that man would do an excellent job protecting his daughter and keeping her safe no matter what.
He didn’t have anything to worry about.
Yrniel, too, would regain all the energy it had wasted on him and get stronger.
Everything would be perfect if...
If he somehow survived.
But...
The Seer thought differently.
"You will not survive, Lord Azriel."
She repeated herself. Then, she shook her head.
"And even if you did survive, what would you do after losing your connection with Yrniel?
You would lose almost all your strength. No matter how you look at it,
You will perish, Lord Azriel.
So stop while you still have the chance.
You cannot succeed."
"I... I need to get stronger..."
Azriel spoke, his voice weaker than before, his desperation, however, was stronger.
His wives, he wanted to revive them, but...
"You cannot become stronger, Lord Azriel."
The Seer shook her head.
"This is the restriction the very Universe has placed on all its beings."
She then got close to Azriel and,

"Do you seriously believe that fool Zylarith’s words? Devouring the Universe’s Will? Do you think the Universe would allow that? Do you think the Universe would make it possible for any being to reach a level of strength where it could threaten its very existence?
Lord Azriel, you are already the strongest being in the Universe. You are already as strong as one in this Universe can be.
You have already reached the Zenith.
There is no way for you to become even stronger."

chapters.title: Chapter 1930: Are you sure you want to do this?
paragraphs: "Lord Azriel, you are already the strongest being in the Universe. You are already as strong as one, in this Universe, can be.
You have already reached the Zenith.
There is no way for you to become even stronger."
The Seer spoke up, setting the restriction.
Azriel stared at the woman in front of him and,
"The Universe makes it impossible for me to get stronger...?"
"That is correct."
The Seer nodded.
"The restrictions it has set are absolute.
A Universe, even since its birth, is always at the threat of being devoured by its own children. Its very instincts tell it to avoid it.
And to do that, our Universe came up with a simple method.
It restricted the strength a single being could have.

Yes, you are the strongest in the Universe, but even you aren’t absolute. There are beings in the Universe that even you would have a hard time defeating, and if they work together, they can even defeat you instead.
For a being to get Absolute Power, one needs to devour the very Universe they were born in.
So how does the Universe protect itself from this threat?
It uses you.
It uses the very beings that are strong enough to threaten it and puts them against each other.
Those beings I mentioned before, the Infinites of the Supreme Worlds,
They keep each other in check, making sure not a single one of them gains too much power.
If they found out about your existence, they would keep you in check as well.
And whether you want it or not, you will keep them in check and protect the Universe from them as well.
The Universe made us that way.
Selfish, manipulative, deceitful, corrupt, cruel, and... greedy for more power.

And the only way it left for us to get the power we want so much is for us to come together, choose one being who would be given the chance to devour the Universe’s Will, and trust that being will not get rid of us all after getting everything he ever wanted."
The Seer’s smile widened and,
"Yes, the only way to get the power we want is to go against our very core of being and trust that others would do the same.
This is how it has survived for trillions of years."
Azriel turned silent.
The Seer then looked into Azriel’s eyes,
"What you are thinking wouldn’t work, Lord Azriel.
Even if you are reborn with all the memories you have, even if you have no restrictions that you currently face,
You will not become stronger than what you currently are. The Universe made us that way."
Once again, the Seer repeated herself, telling Azriel how truly foolish his plan was.
But then,
"What about him?"
Azriel questioned.
The Seer paused.

Without Azriel having to say it, she knew what, or more specifically whom, he was asking about. And the way he was looking at her, the Seer knew he wouldn’t let this go unless she answered his question.
"He is different."
She answered.
"The Universe’s restrictions don’t apply to him.
In theory, Nux can grow as strong as he wants,
Even stronger than the Universe."
"In theory?"
Azriel raised his eyebrows at those words, and the Seer smiled,
"Of course, it is all just a theory for this timeline."
"Does this mean he has achieved that in other timelines?"
"Who knows?"
The Seer just smiled, not answering Azriel’s question.
"What does that mean?"
The Vampire obviously didn’t like that answer.
"I cannot say anything that would make too big of an impact, Lord Azriel. I have no will to calculate more possibilities than I already have."
Then, her tone changed a little.
"...and I can’t possibly afford a mistake at a time like this."
A beautiful smile then appeared on the Seer’s face and,
"To live the beautiful future I saw,
I have to be selfish,
So forgive me if I cannot answer your questions."
She spoke with a look that showed that she was willing to defy even the strongest being in the Universe but...
She hadn’t thought it through.
"Are you sure you want to do this?"
Azriel narrowed his eyes.
Yes, it was a threat.
The Vampire Progenitor was that desperate.
And...
The Seer knew it.
So...
"I have already said what I wanted, so if you don’t mind, I’ll be ending this conversation, Lord Azriel."
"That is not up to you."
Azriel spoke.
This time, the weight behind his voice was much heavier than before.
He had been holding back all this while but...
This was an answer he needed to make a decision.
He could not let this go, he could not let her go.
Therefore, he decided to move.
His crimson eyes shined and suddenly,

The once calm blue sky deformed, morphing into a deep, almost menacing crimson. A giant reddish-white moon loomed above, its overwhelming presence pressing down on the world like the judgment of an indifferent god.
The mountains crumbled into nothingness, trees rotted and decayed in an instant, and the vast and endless oceans disappeared.
The very foundations of the world were erased.
Even the ground the two stood on was no longer there. Instead, it was turned into a bottomless ocean of blood.
This was no longer Yrniel.
It was Azriel’s World.
A reality where he was Absolute.
With a single thought, the very concept of Time was erased.
Not slowed, not disrupted, not frozen.
Erased.
It simply was no more.
The concept of past, present, and future—gone.
The flow of cause and effect collapsed.
The very concept the Seer’s power depended on disappeared.
She was powerless, just like that.
And all this change happened in an instant.
Even Nux, with his impossibly fast thought process and reaction speed, would have been too slow.
Even his Complete Law of Absolute Space was useless here. After all, if Azriel willed it, even the concept of Space could be erased.
This was what it meant to be Absolute.
This was what it meant to be... Azriel.
And...
This was also the reason the Seer was avoiding him in the first place.
Azriel was dangerous, especially when he was provoked.
The Vampire had seen and somewhat understood how her powers worked through Nux’s memories. He knew how she manipulated time to her advantage.
Therefore, he erased time itself.
A simple solution.
Yes, there was no escape. Even someone like the Seer couldn’t escape if Azriel didn’t want her to.
However...
"Once again, I apologize for leaving like this."
The Seer bowed her head as she continued speaking, as if she hadn’t even noticed what was happening around her.
"I hope Lord Azriel takes my words seriously and forgives me for disrespecting him like this."
Then suddenly,
Her body started dematerializing.
’What...?’
Azriel frowned.
This was...
Impossible.
Very quickly, he erased the concept of Dematerialization, and the Seer’s body froze where it was.
This, however, didn’t ease Azriel’s expression. He walked towards the woman in front of him and narrowed his eyes.
After some of her body had disintegrated, he finally saw it.
A strange crystal inside her body.
Azriel’s hand pierced through the Seer’s body. No blood came out. However, seeing how Azriel didn’t react to it, it seemed like he already expected it.
The Vampire Progenitor then brought out the white crystal. The crystal was flickering out of existence.
Then, as Azriel willed it, the crystal returned to how it was a few seconds ago. Its existence became comparatively stable.
Azriel, however, could tell that this crystal wouldn’t last more than the seconds he had bought it.
The Vampire narrowed his eyes at that.
Then, he returned the crystal to the state it was in 3 minutes and 27 seconds ago, the time the Seer had appeared in front of him for the first time.
Then, he reformed the concept of Time in this space and allowed the crystal to do whatever it was supposed to do.
And then it happened.
Another ’Seer’ formed in front of Azriel. Then, she started speaking.
"Lord Azriel, we finally meet."
"Lord Azriel?"
"You aren’t very different from your son-in-law when it comes to dealing with unknowns, huh?"
"Weren’t you the one who wanted to meet me the most?"
"You didn’t.
But you hoped I did."
"You even tried to find me, more than once.
First, it was only for the sake of your daughter, but when you met the Chaos Progenitor and you realized you could bring your wives back to life, you wanted to meet me more than ever."
Exactly the same words and actions...
’A recording...’
Azriel finally realized it.
All this while, he was talking to a recording...
This was also the reason why he couldn’t sense her existence when she appeared in front of him before.
He thought that it was because she was an entity he didn’t understand, thinking it was one of her shenanigans that he didn’t understand, and he didn’t think too much about it...
But to think that was her plan all along...
To think she predicted it all.
No...
She didn’t predict it...
She saw it all.
She knew it all.
She knew what Azriel was going to say. She knew how he was going to act. She knew his desperation, and...
She knew how he was going to react.
She knew he wasn’t going to let her leave, so...
She never came here in the first place.

You are already as strong as one, in this Universe, can be.
You have already reached the Zenith.
There is no way for you to become even stronger."
The Seer spoke up, setting the restriction.
Azriel stared at the woman in front of him and,
"The Universe makes it impossible for me to get stronger...?"
"That is correct."
The Seer nodded.
"The restrictions it has set are absolute.
A Universe, even since its birth, is always at the threat of being devoured by its own children.
Its very instincts tell it to avoid it.
And to do that, our Universe came up with a simple method.
It restricted the strength a single being could have.
Yes, you are the strongest in the Universe, but even you aren’t absolute.
There are beings in the Universe that even you would have a hard time defeating, and if they work together, they can even defeat you instead.
For a being to get Absolute Power, one needs to devour the very Universe they were born in.
So how does the Universe protect itself from this threat?
It uses you.
It uses the very beings that are strong enough to threaten it and puts them against each other.
Those beings I mentioned before, the Infinites of the Supreme Worlds,
They keep each other in check, making sure not a single one of them gains too much power.
If they found out about your existence, they would keep you in check as well.
And whether you want it or not, you will keep them in check and protect the Universe from them as well.
The Universe made us that way.
Selfish, manipulative, deceitful, corrupt, cruel, and... greedy for more power.

And the only way it left for us to get the power we want so much is for us to come together, choose one being who would be given the chance to devour the Universe’s Will, and trust that being will not get rid of us all after getting everything he ever wanted."
The Seer’s smile widened and,
"Yes, the only way to get the power we want is to go against our very core of being and trust that others would do the same.
This is how it has survived for trillions of years."
Azriel turned silent.
The Seer then looked into Azriel’s eyes,
"What you are thinking wouldn’t work, Lord Azriel.
Even if you are reborn with all the memories you have, even if you have no restrictions that you currently face,
You will not become stronger than what you currently are.
The Universe made us that way."
Once again, the Seer repeated herself, telling Azriel how truly foolish his plan was.
But then,
"What about him?"
Azriel questioned.
The Seer paused.
Without Azriel having to say it, she knew what, or more specifically whom, he was asking about.
And the way he was looking at her, the Seer knew he wouldn’t let this go unless she answered his question.
"He is different."
She answered.
"The Universe’s restrictions don’t apply to him.
In theory, Nux can grow as strong as he wants,
Even stronger than the Universe."
"In theory?"
Azriel raised his eyebrows at those words, and the Seer smiled,
"Of course, it is all just a theory for this timeline."
"Does this mean he has achieved that in other timelines?"
"Who knows?"
The Seer just smiled, not answering Azriel’s question.
"What does that mean?"
The Vampire obviously didn’t like that answer.
"I cannot say anything that would make too big of an impact, Lord Azriel.
I have no will to calculate more possibilities than I already have."
Then, her tone changed a little.
"...and I can’t possibly afford a mistake at a time like this."
A beautiful smile then appeared on the Seer’s face and,
"To live the beautiful future I saw,
I have to be selfish,
So forgive me if I cannot answer your questions."
She spoke with a look that showed that she was willing to defy even the strongest being in the Universe but...
She hadn’t thought it through.
"Are you sure you want to do this?"
Azriel narrowed his eyes.
Yes, it was a threat.
The Vampire Progenitor was that desperate.
And...
The Seer knew it.
So...
"I have already said what I wanted, so if you don’t mind, I’ll be ending this conversation, Lord Azriel."
"That is not up to you."
Azriel spoke.
This time, the weight behind his voice was much heavier than before.
He had been holding back all this while but...
This was an answer he needed to make a decision.
He could not let this go, he could not let her go.
Therefore, he decided to move.
His crimson eyes shined and suddenly,
The once calm blue sky deformed, morphing into a deep, almost menacing crimson.
A giant reddish-white moon loomed above, its overwhelming presence pressing down on the world like the judgment of an indifferent god.
The mountains crumbled into nothingness, trees rotted and decayed in an instant, and the vast and endless oceans disappeared.
The very foundations of the world were erased.
Even the ground the two stood on was no longer there.
Instead, it was turned into a bottomless ocean of blood.
This was no longer Yrniel.
It was Azriel’s World.
A reality where he was Absolute.
With a single thought, the very concept of Time was erased.
Not slowed, not disrupted, not frozen.
Erased.
It simply was no more.
The concept of past, present, and future—gone.
The flow of cause and effect collapsed.
The very concept the Seer’s power depended on disappeared.
She was powerless, just like that.
And all this change happened in an instant.
Even Nux, with his impossibly fast thought process and reaction speed, would have been too slow.
Even his Complete Law of Absolute Space was useless here.
After all, if Azriel willed it, even the concept of Space could be erased.
This was what it meant to be Absolute.
This was what it meant to be...
Azriel.
And...
This was also the reason the Seer was avoiding him in the first place.
Azriel was dangerous, especially when he was provoked.
The Vampire had seen and somewhat understood how her powers worked through Nux’s memories.
He knew how she manipulated time to her advantage.
Therefore, he erased time itself.
A simple solution.
Yes, there was no escape.
Even someone like the Seer couldn’t escape if Azriel didn’t want her to.
However...
"Once again, I apologize for leaving like this."
The Seer bowed her head as she continued speaking, as if she hadn’t even noticed what was happening around her.
"I hope Lord Azriel takes my words seriously and forgives me for disrespecting him like this."
Then suddenly,
Her body started dematerializing.
’What...?’
Azriel frowned.
This was...
Impossible.
Very quickly, he erased the concept of Dematerialization, and the Seer’s body froze where it was.
This, however, didn’t ease Azriel’s expression.
He walked towards the woman in front of him and narrowed his eyes.
After some of her body had disintegrated, he finally saw it.
A strange crystal inside her body.
Azriel’s hand pierced through the Seer’s body.
No blood came out.
However, seeing how Azriel didn’t react to it, it seemed like he already expected it.
The Vampire Progenitor then brought out the white crystal.
The crystal was flickering out of existence.
Then, as Azriel willed it, the crystal returned to how it was a few seconds ago.
Its existence became comparatively stable.
Azriel, however, could tell that this crystal wouldn’t last more than the seconds he had bought it.
The Vampire narrowed his eyes at that.
Then, he returned the crystal to the state it was in 3 minutes and 27 seconds ago, the time the Seer had appeared in front of him for the first time.
Then, he reformed the concept of Time in this space and allowed the crystal to do whatever it was supposed to do.
And then it happened.
Another ’Seer’ formed in front of Azriel.
Then, she started speaking.
"Lord Azriel, we finally meet."
"Lord Azriel?"
"You aren’t very different from your son-in-law when it comes to dealing with unknowns, huh?"
"Weren’t you the one who wanted to meet me the most?"
"You didn’t.
But you hoped I did."
"You even tried to find me, more than once.
First, it was only for the sake of your daughter, but when you met the Chaos Progenitor and you realized you could bring your wives back to life, you wanted to meet me more than ever."
Exactly the same words and actions...
’A recording...’
Azriel finally realized it.
All this while, he was talking to a recording...
This was also the reason why he couldn’t sense her existence when she appeared in front of him before.
He thought that it was because she was an entity he didn’t understand, thinking it was one of her shenanigans that he didn’t understand, and he didn’t think too much about it...
But to think that was her plan all along...
To think she predicted it all.
No...
She didn’t predict it...
She saw it all.
She knew it all.
She knew what Azriel was going to say.
She knew how he was going to act.
She knew his desperation, and...
She knew how he was going to react.
She knew he wasn’t going to let her leave, so...
She never came here in the first place.

chapters.title: Chapter 1931: Where are you going? *
paragraphs: "You look tired~"
Nux chuckled as he tightened his hug around the Vampire lying on his bed next to him, naked.
"Mmmhm~"
Aeliana didn’t answer; she was still sleepy.
She didn’t know how long she had slept for; she just knew she was exhausted. Even though her regeneration had already healed her exhaustion, she was still exhausted.
And of course, feeling Nux’s strong chest touching her bare back, making her feel a comfort she had never experienced before, didn’t help with the exhaustion either.
It was as if Nux was pulling her deep into a sea of comfort and laziness.
For the next few minutes, she wanted to not think about anything else and just lie down, just like this.
Which wouldn’t have been a problem; after all, everyone deserved a few minutes of rest.
But...
The Vampire had been feeling this way for a few hours now.
Her mind just couldn’t get enough of this, and she wanted more.
A few more minutes, then more minutes, and then more...
She wanted Nux and this moment all to herself.
"How are you so tired? You have slept for three days, you know?"
Nux chuckled as he rubbed his body against hers. He was so close to her that he could practically feel her heart beating rhythmically, something that calmed him.
"I am like this because you cheated."
Aeliana answered, and at those words, Nux chuckled.
"You still haven’t given up on that, huh?"
"You cheated."
She repeated again.
"Yes, yes, I cheated."

Nux admitted as he coiled around her body. His hand grabbed her unbelievably soft breasts and pulled her close to him. His legs wrapped themselves around hers, while his little brother very clearly settled right between her thighs in a position that couldn’t be more comfortable.
It was almost as if they had become one. Nux didn’t even allow air to pass through them, and Aeliana had no complaints whatsoever.
"Try defeating me next time~"
Nux smiled.
"Who is to say that you won’t cheat again?"
Aeliana questioned as she snuggled her body close to him. It honestly wasn’t even possible to get any closer; no one knew what the Vampire was trying to do.
The heat coming from Nux’s body just felt too comforting.
At her question, Nux brought his mouth dangerously close to her ear, and like a demon seducing someone to do what he wanted, he whispered into her ear,
"Then you can try again, can’t you?"
Aeliana’s body trembled at those words. Nux just tightened his hug around her and,
"We have all eternity together~
If you try again,
And again,
And again,
And then again,
One day, you are bound to know all my tricks, no?
Then I won’t be able to cheat."
"T-That sounds good..."
Aeliana answered, already creating scenarios in her head that she didn’t want anyone to know about.

Her face flushed. Nux smiled at that as he kissed her neck, making her body tremble. What made it even worse was that Nux was wrapped around her entire body like a snake; she couldn’t even tremble freely.
In the end, Aeliana just closed her eyes. The comfort was too much for her; she couldn’t stay awake. Nux continued to kiss her lightly, putting her to sleep.
He felt her rhythmic heartbeat, and once he was sure she was asleep, his body turned into Mist and flew out of the bed without waking her up.
Or at least... that is what he thought, but the moment Aeliana’s ’comfort’ was gone,
"Where are you going?"
She opened her eyes and questioned.
The Mist turned back into Nux again.
"You are awake?"
"I have slept enough."
Aeliana replied as she then sat up. The blanket that covered her dropped down, revealing her flawless body.
But suddenly, the Vampire frowned as she sensed something.
She then turned towards Nux and narrowed her eyes,
"You wanted me to sleep."
Nux didn’t know what to say.
"Take me with you."
Aeliana ordered, and in the end, Nux just nodded.

He extended his hand, Aeliana slowly grabbed it as a new set of clothes covered her body. Nux wore a new set as well, and then, they teleported out of Core and returned to Yrniel, right in front of Azriel.
"Took you long enough."
Azriel, who was sitting on top of a Sky Kingdom’s castle, invisible to the rest, stared at the two of them hovering in the air, knowing very well that they could see him.
"Father..."
Aeliana called out in worry, seeing her father’s state.
"What is it?"
Nux, on the other hand, questioned directly.
Azriel had sealed his surroundings, not allowing him or anyone else to watch what had happened, but Nux didn’t need to see it in order to know what had happened.
He had met the Seer before; he knew what state she left one in.
Azriel was no different.
And considering how he had been waiting for them for a month now, Nux could tell something was going on.
Yes, a month had passed since Azriel had met the Seer and...
He still hadn’t returned to his sleep.
He was awake, Yrniel was experiencing its second Mana Apocalypse, the Progenitors were all worried, and Nux, who was with Aeliana inside the Core, could sense it.
This was also the reason Aeliana decided to come here.
She knew her father was awake, but...
She didn’t know why.
She just knew that something was going on with her father, and she wanted to be with him at this moment.
"Sit."
Azriel ordered.
Nux paused. He looked around; they were literally on top of the castle. No, not on the roof, on top of the Dome.
"Does it hav-"
"Sit."
Azriel repeated, and Nux did as he was told. Aeliana followed.
"Do you know what this castle is called?"
Azriel questioned.
"Sky Castle."
Nux answered.
This place belonged to his wife’s uncle; of course, he knew about it.
"How do you think it got this name?"
"From the Sky Family that rules it?"
Nux guessed.
After all, the Vampire Royal Family had the same last name, it wouldn’t be surprising if they named this castle on their name. Royal Families usually did things like that.
Azriel, however, smiled at those words. His palm then touched the castle dome he was sitting on, and his smile became a lot gentler.
"It was given this name to respect a woman named Ithania Sky."
"Ithania..."
"My wife."

chapters.title: Chapter 1932: Are you... giving up?
paragraphs: "It was given this name to respect a woman named Ithania Sky."
"Ithania..."
"My wife."
"Ithania Sky..."
Nux muttered, nnecting the dots.
"So the Vampire Royal Family are your descendants?"
He questioned.
"All Vampires are my descendants, brat."
"You know that is not what I am talking about."
Nux replied, and once again, Azriel smiled at those words.
’He is smiling a lot.’
Nux nodded as he then narrowed his eyes.
’A little too much.’
He didn’t like this.
For some reason, he preferred his father-in-law to be that rude and arrogant man instead of... whatever this was.
"No, they are not my descendants."
Azriel shook his head. He then glanced at Aeliana and,
"She is my only true daughter."
"Then Lady Ithania..."
"No, not her descendants either."
Azriel shook his head.
"Lia is her only true daughter as well."
A small smile appeared on Aeliana’s face when she heard that.
"The Sky Castle was created by the founder of the Sky Family, one of Ithania’s most loyal and closest named subordinates, Valerian Sky."
"Valerian Sky..."
Aeliana muttered. She had heard of that name.
The ancestor of the Sky Family, one of the strongest Vampires in Yrniel.
"Heh."
Azriel suddenly laughed.
"To think thatward is now hailed as one of the founders of the Vampire Royal Family, how amusing~"
Nux frowned at those words.
Today, he realized that he truly didn’t like his father-in-law laughing. The more he did it, the stranger he felt.
"Well, he may be award, but that guy was quite loyal. Hiswardice was also the reason why Ithania trusted him the most.
She knew he would survivempared to the other two, who would just foolishly run towards their death."
Azrielntinued his story.
"You know, Aeliana takes after Ithania. Well, she takes after both her mothers, but the way she thinks things through and predicts what is going to happen is something Ithania was very good at.
She predicted Valerian would survive, and he did.
And...
She said the other two would rush to their own deaths... and that is what they did."
Nux was silent.
He wanted to know what his father-in-law was getting at.
Aeliana was the same.
"Honestly, with how reasonable she was, I expected her to... survive. Someone like her would never run to her own death."
Azriel spoke. Then, with his crimson eyes, he turned towards Nux and,
"Or maybe... she was expecting something?
Maybe she thought I would be able to save her?"
"Lord Azr-"
"Nux."
Before Nuxuld say anything, Azriel called out.
"What drives you to get stronger?"
He questioned.
"My wives."
Nux’s answer was instantaneous.
"You already have your wives."
"But I am not strong enough to protect them. I wish to bme so strong that no one would dare to go against me or my wives."

"Why not just devour all your wives, live in your own universe, and neverme out again? Nobody will know. Even if they do, locating your universe and actually being able to enter it will be next to impossible."
"That might have satisfied me before, not now."
Nux shrugged.
Azriel stared at him, waiting for him to explain.
"As exciting as living in my universe with my wives where no one bothers us sounds, that would make us... runaways."
Azriel’s expression changed, and Nux grinned.
"I do not wish to hide. I wish to bme the strongest. I wish to roam around wherever I want with my wives without having to worry about anything."
"You are getting greedier."
Azrielmmented.
"Well, that kinda has been my thing from the very beginning."
Nux shrugged, and Azriel nodded with a light smile on his face.
"You have no limits."
Azriel started.
"One day, you will bme so strong that no one in the universe will be able to stop you."
Nux narrowed his eyes, not liking where this was going.
"You will bme strong enough to do what that father of yours wants you to."
The Vampire Progenitor then stared at his son-in-law and,
"The Universe’s Will.
You are the only one who has the potential to devour it and bme the Absolute God."
Azriel admitted.
He was praising his son-in-law and acknowledging his potential, but...
"Are you... giving up?"
Nux questioned directly, unable to believe what he just heard.
He still remembered how he and his father-in-law made a bet regarding who would reach the very top of the universe and devour its Will.
Heck, half of the reason he wanted to do this was because he wanted to prove himself in front of the man he respected.
But...
For Azriel to outright admit that he was the only one who had the potential to devour the Universe’s Will, did this mean he was... quitting their race?
Nux clenched his fists. He was...
Disappointed.

He didn’t know what it was. Honestly, he should have been happiernsidering he wouldn’t have to worry aboutmpeting with his father-in-law, but something inside him just didn’t like the sound of Azriel Ruinous quitting.
Was it because Azriel was his father-in-law?
No, that was not it.
It was something else.
Azriel was the man he respected?
No, it was not just a mere respect, Nux respected quite a few men but...
Azriel was the only one he truly looked up to.
All this while... Nuxmpared himself to him.
Yes, that was it.
Azriel was Nux’s idol.
He was a man Nux looked up to and wanted to be like.
He imagined his future self to be as arrogant as Azriel was. He wanted his future self to be... as absolute as his father-in-law was.
And to see his future self giving up like this...
It felt... gnawing.
But then,
"Promise me, Nux Leander."
Azriel called out.
"Huh?"
Nux frowned, looking at Azriel again.
"Promise me that you will reach your potential and bme Absolute.
Then,
You will revive me."
"What...?"
Azriel then grinned and,
"If I fail, that is."
The Vampire’s grin then widened and,
"If I do not,
Then the race is still on, child.
I wish you luck."
"Wait-"
"Fathe-"
BOOOOOOOOOOM

"Or maybe... she was expecting something?
Maybe she thought I would be able to save her?"
"Lord Azr-"
"Nux."
Before Nuxuld say anything, Azriel called out.
"What drives you to get stronger?"
He questioned.
"My wives."
Nux’s answer was instantaneous.
"You already have your wives."
"But I am not strong enough to protect them.
I wish to bme so strong that no one would dare to go against me or my wives."
"Why not just devour all your wives, live in your own universe, and neverme out again?
Nobody will know.
Even if they do, locating your universe and actually being able to enter it will be next to impossible."
"That might have satisfied me before, not now."
Nux shrugged.
Azriel stared at him, waiting for him to explain.
"As exciting as living in my universe with my wives where no one bothers us sounds, that would make us... runaways."
Azriel’s expression changed, and Nux grinned.
"I do not wish to hide.
I wish to bme the strongest.
I wish to roam around wherever I want with my wives without having to worry about anything."
"You are getting greedier."
Azrielmmented.
"Well, that kinda has been my thing from the very beginning."
Nux shrugged, and Azriel nodded with a light smile on his face.
"You have no limits."
Azriel started.
"One day, you will bme so strong that no one in the universe will be able to stop you."
Nux narrowed his eyes, not liking where this was going.
"You will bme strong enough to do what that father of yours wants you to."
The Vampire Progenitor then stared at his son-in-law and,
"The Universe’s Will.
You are the only one who has the potential to devour it and bme the Absolute God."
Azriel admitted.
He was praising his son-in-law and acknowledging his potential, but...
"Are you... giving up?"
Nux questioned directly, unable to believe what he just heard.
He still remembered how he and his father-in-law made a bet regarding who would reach the very top of the universe and devour its Will.
Heck, half of the reason he wanted to do this was because he wanted to prove himself in front of the man he respected.
But...
For Azriel to outright admit that he was the only one who had the potential to devour the Universe’s Will, did this mean he was... quitting their race?
Nux clenched his fists.
He was...
Disappointed.
He didn’t know what it was.
Honestly, he should have been happiernsidering he wouldn’t have to worry aboutmpeting with his father-in-law, but something inside him just didn’t like the sound of Azriel Ruinous quitting.
Was it because Azriel was his father-in-law?
No, that was not it.
It was something else.
Azriel was the man he respected?
No, it was not just a mere respect, Nux respected quite a few men but...
Azriel was the only one he truly looked up to.
All this while...
Nuxmpared himself to him.
Yes, that was it.
Azriel was Nux’s idol.
He was a man Nux looked up to and wanted to be like.
He imagined his future self to be as arrogant as Azriel was.
He wanted his future self to be... as absolute as his father-in-law was.
And to see his future self giving up like this...
It felt... gnawing.
But then,
"Promise me, Nux Leander."
Azriel called out.
"Huh?"
Nux frowned, looking at Azriel again.
"Promise me that you will reach your potential and bme Absolute.
Then,
You will revive me."
"What...?"
Azriel then grinned and,
"If I fail, that is."
The Vampire’s grin then widened and,
"If I do not,
Then the race is still on, child.
I wish you luck."
"Wait-"
"Fathe-"
BOOOOOOOOOOM

Before Nux and Aelianauld say anything, a deafening explosion shook the entire Yrniel. Yrniel’s sky turned crimson as it trembled violently, distorting the very space around itself. Unable to hold out any longer, Yrniel’s spatial fabric started cracking.
The ground cracked, the air twisted, and an energy so pure, dense, and endless was released that even Nuxuldn’t believe his eyes.
This energy...
It was much higher than what heuld release, even if he used the energy of Umbrasol and all other worlds that were inside his Universe.
It was...
The energy of the World.

Raw energy of the World that wasn’t inntrol any longer. An energy that released so much pressure that no being in Yrnieluld resist. Once again, everyone passed out. Even Nux and Aeliana would have been the same, but...
The same energy that weighed others down, surrounded them as if protecting them from everything happening around them.
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
THUNDER THUNDER THUNDER
Yrniel cried.
This energy...
It was the energy that belonged to it.
This endless amount of energyuld make it as strong as it was supposed to be, a world much stronger than any High-Level World.
It was a good thing. The energy was all for it to take, but...
Yrniel still cried, and when Nux finally realized what was happening, he glanced at Azriel, his eyes widening in horror.
Azriel’s body was breaking apart.
"FATHER!!!"
Aeliana screamed, rushing towards him. Nux, however, grabbed her hand and pulled her back.
"NUX! WHAT ARE YOU-"
"You cannot go. His body would perish with even the smallest force."
Nux spoke, his voice much heavier than usual as he stared at his father-in-law in front of him.
"What...?"
Aeliana felt a chill down her spine, unable to believe what she just heard.
She turned towards her father, wanting to hear that all of this was a lie, but...
Azriel just smiled.
His Blood Essence, which had been holding on to Yrniel’s Energy, finally let it go, risking its very own existence.
No, risking was a hopeful word. This was no different than self-destruction.

Almost all of Azriel’s Blood Essence was made of Yrniel’s Core Energy. His very existence was being supported by Yrniel. The moment he gave it up, his Blood Essence... dissolved, unable to hold out any longer.
His face became paler and paler until his fleshuldn’t take it anymore and dissolved into a thick, crimson mist.

It was over. Azriel’s very existence was being erased because his blood didn’t exist anymore. Everything he did so far, everything that went against the Universe’s Rules, giving a part of his Blood Essence to his wives to strengthen them, burning his Blood Essence to strengthen himself and face an enemy heuldn’t defeat, and even giving birth to Aeliana, strengthening her much more than a normal Yrniel’s Vampire should be...

All his mistakes, which werevered by Yrniel’s Core Energy, were now being revealed, and his very existence, which should have perished if not for Yrniel protecting him, was now... perishing since he abandoned Yrniel’s protection.
This... was true annihilation.
The Vampire Progenitor then turned towards his daughter, his expression so gentle and calming as if everything was under hisntrol.
"Aeliana..."
He called out, his deep, steady voice cutting through the chaos.
"Father!"
Aeliana, whould barely believe what was happening, reacted instantly when she heard her father’s voice.
In her mind, she was still expecting her all-powerful father to do something, anything, and return to her.
She wanted him to say something that would calm her down. She wanted him to tell her that everything would be alright, just like always, but...
"Take care."
Just two words.
A simple farewell.
And yet, for Aeliana, those two words were far more terrifying than anything else.
"FATHER!!"
She screamed, tears streaming down her eyes without stop. Her body trembled. If it wasn’t for Nux holding her, she would have longllapsed.
Not again...
Sheuldn’t lose her father a snd time.
Azriel, who saw his daughter like this, closed his eyes.
This was for the best.
Nux was here.
He knew his son-in-law would take care of his daughter, and because he knew that...
Azriel decided to be selfish this one time.
It was too painful, living in a world without his wives next to him.
It was... lonely.
Even someone like Azrieluldn’t take it any longer.
So he decided to risk it all.
All for...
One last fighting chance, one last struggle to get back what he had lost.
One last chance to bring his wives back to him or... go to them.

Nux, who saw tears in his wife’s eyes, felt his heart breaking. Hisnnection with Aeliana was already much stronger after the illusion. He had sworn to himself that he would never let her be sad no matter what...
Yet here he was... helpless when his wife was crying...
Frustration, helplessness, and... anger...
All these emotions overwhelmed him, and as he stared at the perishing Azriel, all these intense emotions were directed at someone else.
"It was the Seer, wasn’t it?"
Nux spoke up, his body trembling in rage.
"She must have enticed you into believing that this was the way out. So that was the reason she wanted to meet you in the first place. Her goal wasn’t me, but you. I should have kno-"
"She told me not to do it."
Azriel smiled at Nux’s words.
"She wanted to meet me because she knew I was planning on doing it and told me not to."
"Then why di-"
Before Aelianauld evenmplete her question,
"I was selfish."
Then, a blood-red tear came out of Azriel’s eyes, and as he looked at his daughter one last time,
"I am sorry."
"No—Father, wai—!"
As if he had said his final words, Azriel’s entire body turned into Blood Mist and...
It disappeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 1934: That woman knows everything, doesn’t she?
paragraphs: BOOOM
"I-I broke through again! I am a Semi-Saint now!"
"Already? But you just became a Great Sage five years ago."
"I-I don’t know! Ever since the Second Mana Apocalypse that ended a week ago, Mana density has become much thicker. I feel like I cultivate as I breathe. Cultivation has never felt easier!"
"Indeed, I feel like I am about to break through as well."
"You are about to break through!? But you have been stuck at the Semi-Saint Stage for decades now!"
"Mhm, I feel like everything that had been holding me back somehow... disappeared.
Something changed after the Second Mana Apocalypse."
The man replied as he looked out of his window, staring at the crimson sky that hadn’t disappeared since the Second Mana Apocalypse.
Yes, for the past two weeks, Yrniel hadn’t experienced any days or nights. It was just this ominous crimson sky that reigned over them all.

At first, people were scared, worried as to what was about to happen. But the moment they sensed the dense mana in the air and how this density was continuing to increase every single day without slowing down,
They started treating the Crimson Sky as a good omen. Something was happening. Yrniel was changing, and it was changing for the better.
And these changes...
They were far more terrifying than one normally believed.
The Semi-Saint Stage Cultivator glanced at the 7-year-old daughter of one of the most prestigious inns in the town, pointing at the crimson sky.
"Mother, why is the sky red...?"
The little girl questioned innocently.
Her mother, who was folding her clothes, smiled at that question and,
"You start your cultivation journey today, don’t you? This is Yrniel trying to cheer you up."
"Really!?"
The little girl’s eyes brightened up.
"Yes, you like the color red, don’t you?"
"I do! It is so beautiful! The sky looks so beautiful!"
"Indeed, Yrniel made the sky beautiful so you will work hard and become the best cultivator."
"I will do that!"
The little girl nodded excitedly as she took out a cultivation book that her mother gave her.
And no, this wasn’t a normal book. It was a Cultivation Method that was previously known as Harakiri.
A Path only the Yrniel Heroes and Cultivators from the Order followed.
A Path that was notorious for killing one’s potential because of how difficult it is, but now...

The Ancestral Order had distributed this Path to everyone in Yrniel, stating that they were about to usher in a New Era, where everyone could be as strong as the Heroes and reach stages far higher than Divine.
They even introduced cultivation stages above Divine: Primordial, Transcendent, and then... Eternal.
The concept of Laws was introduced—Absolute Laws, Dependent Laws, ways to form these Laws. All sorts of things were revealed.
The Cultivation Path, which everyone believed was supposed to end at the Divine Stage, had now become even larger and grander.
And the only way one could walk on this Path was to become one of those Harakiri Cultivators, or... the Complete Cultivators.
A New Era,
An Era where the current Kings and Queens in power, the Incomplete Divines who were known to be Absolute, would become nothing but old-timers with washed-out cultivation.
An Era where new, much stronger Cultivators would take over. An Era... of the new Generation of Cultivation.

Yrniel would soon plunge into Chaos as everyone would participate in this race for greatness. Kings would be dethroned, lazy nobles would face public rage, and even a common man with nothing in his hands would get a fair chance to change his fate.
Something very big was about to happen.
And the old cultivators...
They looked forward to this change and were intimidated at the same time.
On the other side, at the top of the Sky Castle, Aeliana was sitting in the place Azriel was before he disappeared. She stared at the Crimson Sky, her eyes showing no emotion whatsoever.
Yes, for the past two weeks, she had been sitting here, still hoping her father would return.
Her father’s little girl still hopelessly believed that her father would return and...
She wasn’t alone.
Even Yrniel itself was with her, believing the same thing.
Even now, Yrniel hadn’t absorbed the energy Azriel had released. The only energy it had absorbed was the one it was forced to, or else it would have dissipated.
Yes, the very World was holding the energy, waiting for its protector to return. The Crimson Sky that everyone wondered about—that was all Azriel’s Energy.
But... it couldn’t go on for long.
Yrniel had already waited for 2 weeks. If it didn’t absorb this energy today, all of it would disperse, and it knew that.
Therefore,
Whoosh Whoosh Whoosh
A Giant Vortex formed in the Sky as Yrniel started absorbing the energy.
It had given up, and...
It was time for Aeliana to give up as well.
Azriel Ruinous would not return.
"Aeliana."
Nux called out.
There was no response.
"Are you planning on sitting here forever?"
Nux questioned, but once again, Aeliana didn’t respond.
"How weak~
I was worried for nothing, eh?"
Suddenly, another voice was heard.
It was Amaya.
Yes, she and everyone else were here as well.
They had been silent all this while, but now, Amaya couldn’t hold back anymore.
Amaya then glanced at Nux and,
"I thought she was like me and was worried for a second, but I guess we are quite different, eh?
After all, if I was in her stead, I would have long stopped grieving and would have been planning my revenge instead."
"Revenge...?"
At those words, Felberta narrowed her eyes.
Revenge against whom?
She wondered in her head.
Was she just saying it for the sake of getting a response out of her?
That was one possibility.
But,
"What are you so surprised about?
Are we not going to avenge Lord Azriel?"
Amaya questioned as she then glanced at Aeliana and,
"I thought we were going after the Seer."
"What?"
Vyriana’s expression changed.
"What did she do?"
The Dragon questioned.
"Oh, come on now."
Amaya spoke in a tone full of mockery,
"That woman knows everything, doesn’t she?"
Amaya then glanced at the rest and,
"Do you really believe... that she didn’t know exactly how her words would push Lord Azriel to his decision?"
The instant she said those words, the women’s expressions changed. Even Aeliana’s eyes flickered, and when she saw that, Amaya’s grin widened.

"I was thinking of ways to avenge Lord Azriel since she was one of our sisters, but if sitting here for a few years and then forgetting about it was all she is going to do, then I guess I don’t have to bother either."
The Devourer then chuckled and,
"Who knows?
Maybe the Seer also knew that this is how she was going to react, and since she didn’t see any possible downsides, she went with it.
How amusing~
Her powers are really convenient, aren’t they?"
Once again, the Devourer glanced at Aeliana and,
"She even knows who’s just a coward behind all that strong front and can find her targets accordingly. I truly envy that~"
And at those words, Aeliana finally reacted.
"That is enough."
She spoke, glaring at Amaya. A blood spear formed right in front of the Devourer’s neck, ready to rip her apart. Seeing that spear, Amaya smiled.
"Good to have you back.
Now let’s get to work, shall we? We would need a plan of action, and I really think you will need your new family’s help in this one."
The rest of the women, and Nux, smiled at those words, all nodding at Aeliana.
None of them—not even Nux—noticed the faint wisp of crimson mist drifting aimlessly through the Outer Space near Yrniel, on the verge of vanishing into nothingness.
Flicker
But before it could fade completely, it suddenly flickered and disappeared,
As if it was teleported away by some foreign, unknown force.
