"I was thinking of ways to avenge Lord Azriel since she was one of our sisters, but if sitting here for a few years and then forgetting about it was all she is going to do, then I guess I don’t have to bother either."
The Devourer then chuckled and,
"Who knows?
Maybe the Seer also knew that this is how she was going to react, and since she didn’t see any possible downsides, she went with it.
How amusing~
Her powers are really convenient, aren’t they?"
Once again, the Devourer glanced at Aeliana and,
"She even knows who’s just a coward behind all that strong front and can find her targets accordingly.
I truly envy that~"
And at those words, Aeliana finally reacted.
"That is enough."
She spoke, glaring at Amaya.
A blood spear formed right in front of the Devourer’s neck, ready to rip her apart.
Seeing that spear, Amaya smiled.
"Good to have you back.
Now let’s get to work, shall we?
We would need a plan of action, and I really think you will need your new family’s help in this one."
The rest of the women, and Nux, smiled at those words, all nodding at Aeliana.
None of them—not even Nux—noticed the faint wisp of crimson mist drifting aimlessly through the Outer Space near Yrniel, on the verge of vanishing into nothingness.
Flicker
But before it could fade completely, it suddenly flickered and disappeared,
As if it was teleported away by some foreign, unknown force.

chapters.title: Chapter 1935: Calm down.
paragraphs: While Nux and the others discussed matters related to the Seer and tried to come up with a way to deal with her, a faint wisp of crimson mist drifted aimlessly through the Outer Space near Yrniel, on the verge of vanishing into nothingness.
Flicker
But before it could fade completely, it flickered—just once—before disappearing entirely, as if plucked from existence by some foreign, unseen force.
When it reappeared, it was no longer near Yrniel. It was not even within the scope of the ever-expanding Universe.
It was a place of—
Nothingness.
No Universal Energy. No stars. No worlds. Not even a single speck of dust.
Even the Almighty Four Supreme Worlds knew nothing of this void.
And within this endless emptiness... only this wisp of crimson mist floated.
Drifting.
Wandering.
Persisting.
Though weak, it did not vanish as it should have.
In this empty, timeless abyss, it was the only thing that existed.
Until—
This empty space shuddered.
The mist trembled.
It was subtle. There were no winds, no thundering roars, no absurdly powerful auras.
Just... silence.
Yet something within the emptiness shifted. Slowly, something began to materialize.
It started as a simple flicker of existence, then grew more vivid, more real, until finally...
A white sphere materialized.
A sphere quite similar to the World Cores Nux had devoured.
But there was one difference—this one was far, far larger, so much that it couldn’t even be put into words.
Even Umbrasol and Colossa, two of the largest worlds in the Universe, would look like mere pebbles before it.
Yes, it was the Universe’s Core.
The physical manifestation of the Will of the Universe itself.
Something that the strongest in the Universe sought, yet... none could claim it.
Something that had survived the test of time for trillions of years.
Before such an overwhelming entity, the faint wisp of mist should have been invisible—utterly insignificant.
And yet...
For some reason, it wasn’t.
The Universe’s Will stared at the mist.
Not in a way one could describe with mortal understanding, but it was aware of the mist—acknowledging it.
The mist, however, remained oblivious. It drifted, unaware, mindless, continuing its aimless path through the void.
Then—
Bzzzt
The Universe’s Core trembled, and in that instant, the very fabric of the space around it rippled, as if unable to contain even its weakest movement.
And that ripple in space gave birth to something new.
A strange energy.
An energy that could not be understood.
It did not move. It did not spread. It simply existed.
Hovering.
Almost as if...
It was waiting.
And then—
The crimson mist changed its course, as if some foreign force was directing its flow.
It was subtle at first, but then it became undeniable—it was being drawn toward the energy.
The mist got closer... and closer...
Until—
It passed through the energy.
And then—
Something changed.
The faint wisp, once weak and barely clinging to existence—almost on the verge of fading out of existence, in fact—began to grow.
It thickened.
It solidified.
The once-dying mist grew more vivid, more... substantial—until finally—
Ba-dump
A heartbeat echoed throughout the silent, vast space.
A sign of life where nothing existed. And at last,
The Vampire Progenitor’s Regeneration kicked in.
With so many things happening all over the Universe, once again, inside that big room, on top of the ridiculously big table, four entities gathered.
At first, there was silence.
No one spoke.
It was a show of patience. All four entities had everything under their control, or at least that’s the impression they were trying to give.
Or maybe...
It was something else.
Maybe it was some method to... assess each other.
Though whatever it was, it clearly wasn’t very effective. What these entities had the most in their hands was time. Staying silent for a few hours was nothing for them, and they all knew it.
So, not wanting to foolishly stay here while they could be doing something useful, the Entity of Eternity started,
"The Seer made an appearance."
"Did you find out where?"
The Entity of Balance questioned.
"I did not."
The Entity of Eternity denied.
"Why do I feel like you are becoming more and more useless? You never have an answer to any of our questions now."
The Entity of Malice spoke directly.
He was in no mood to play this foolish game, and it was showing.
The Entity of Eternity, however, didn’t lose its calm.

"Why do you think I am obliged to answer your question? The very reason you ask me is because you do not have the answer to that question. It also proves that subconsciously, you know I know more than you do. And if you call me useless even when you know you stand below me, I can only imagine how you look at yourself."
"What did you say?"
The Entity of Malice raised its voice.
"You heard me."
The Entity of Eternity didn’t back down either.
After all, no one here was particularly weaker than anyone. Yes, the Entity of Malice was strong. In terms of battle power, it probably could overpower the Entity of Eternity, but...
Battle power was not everything one needed in a war.
Especially when more than two factions are involved in it.

The Entity of Eternity wasn’t intimidated. It had no reason to. After all, it already knew nothing was going to happen. It knew that even if the Entity of Malice lost its calm, as it usually did, the other two would make a move.
They had to.
Because if they didn’t, then the truth would be revealed, and all others would turn towards them instead.
The tension in the air rose as the Entity of Malice stayed silent, and the other three entities observed even that action very carefully, as if trying to find a clue.
Yes, it was clear that for some reason, the balance between the Four Supreme Entities was very delicate right now. It was almost as if they were trying to find a reason to fight each other.
But in the end,
"Calm down."
The Entity of Balance spoke up.

chapters.title: Chapter 1936: Universe’s Child.
paragraphs: "Calm down."
The Entity of Balance spoke up, its voice breaking the tension forming between the two entities.
"Let us continue the discussion. Eternity, do you know anything about the Seer’s whereabouts?"
It questioned, but once again, Eternity’s answer remained the same.
"I do not.
She is purposefully hiding her tracks."
"Why would she do that? She is trying to hide something."
The Entity of Balance couldn’t understand.
"Who knows? We all knew she was never on our side to begin with. We never managed to truly figure her out."
Eternity answered, its voice calm as usual.
"But she has never done something like this before."
Balance spoke in a heavy tone.
Eternity remained silent.
It had no answer to this.
It did, however, have one possible theory.
"Is it possible that... she found the Anomaly?"
Suddenly, the Entity of Light questioned, and in an instant, everyone else turned towards it.
What it said wasn’t wrong. Actually, that was the theory the Entity of Eternity had in its mind, but the reason it didn’t say it out loud was because it knew what effect it would have.
"You have been oddly silent today."
The Entity of Malice spoke up, its tone full of suspicion.
"What do you mean?"
The Entity of Light’s tone became heavier; it seemed to have realized its mistake.

"I simply stated that there are chances that the Seer found the Anomaly and sided with it. It is also highly likely that the Anomaly was her goal all along and she had been waiting for it all this while.
If we can figure out the relationship between the two of them, then it is possible to understand more about the situation."
It quickly explained its thought process.
The Entity of Malice, however, didn’t sound convinced.

You felt that you had been silent for too long, and not wanting to be found out, you decided to add something to the conversation—something that would bring the discussion back to the Anomaly, a being that doesn’t even matter anymore."
"What are you—"
Before the Entity of Light could say anything to clarify, the Entity of Malice flickered, then,
"It is you, isn’t it?"
The Entity of Light flickered as well, but Malice didn’t stop.
"It would make sense, after all.
You would not want any unnecessary destruction. You are currently weak because of the War, so you wouldn’t instantly come to power either. You are indeed the safest choice."
"Trust me, if it were me, I would have ended your existence already."
"How bloodthirsty."
Malice’s voice sounded like it was grinning.
"So it made you that strong, huh?
What restrictions did it impose on you?
What did it tell you to do? Find the Anomaly? Is that why you wanted to find it?

How strong have you gotten? Are you strong enough to take all of us on your own? No, that shouldn’t be the case. Two of us at the same time? That might be possible. Or considering how passive you have been, maybe you are only strong enough to take on one of us?
Heh, this sure has become interesting, hasn’t it, Universe’s Chosen?"
Malice spoke, its voice sounding like it was grinning ear to ear. However, everyone knew it wasn’t the least bit amused. The rage and malice in its voice were apparent.
And just like it, the other three Entities, including the Entity of Light it was blaming, seemed tense as well.
And how could they not?
After all, the Universe had chosen its Child.
Yes, a Universe’s Child was born—a child with endless potential, a child that had power that no being in the entire Universe should possess.
Usually, the Universe would never create such a being, but because of the Anomaly’s actions and its inability to stop it, the Universe had no choice but to choose a living entity as its protector.
And of course, the Four Entities knew that as the strongest beings in the entire Universe, or in other words, beings closest to the Universe, the said Child was...
One of them.
Yes, one of them had received almost endless potential—the potential to surpass them all and become strong enough to get rid of them alone.
It was a crisis.

After all, while it may seem like it, the Four Supreme Worlds have never been allies. On the contrary, they have always been at each other’s throats, waiting for one to show even a moment of weakness and using that chance to get rid of them.
The same happened with the Supreme World of Chaos, and the same would happen with any of them who became too weak or... too strong.
The Universe choosing a Hero to get rid of the Anomaly may be good for it, but for the Supreme Worlds, it was the worst possible news.
After all, whoever the Universe’s Chosen was, it would come for the other three the moment it was strong enough to get rid of them.
This was also the reason the Supreme Worlds wanted to find the Anomaly so desperately, even though it wasn’t exactly targeting them.
No, they weren’t scared of the Anomaly. They were scared of... each other.
And now, what they were scared of... had happened.
Yes, it happened much quicker than they were expecting. It was also something worth investigating, but for now, what mattered the most was that the Universal Political Dynamics had changed.
The Supreme Worlds were no longer allies, even for the sake of appearances.
There was a Universe’s Chosen amongst them, and they needed to find out who it was before it got too strong for them.
As for the Anomaly they all were so desperately after...
It was no longer important.
It was the Universe’s Chosen’s problem now.
Or maybe...
It was now bait they could use to find the Universe’s Chosen.
But for now...
What the Four Supreme Worlds had to worry about was...
"That’s an interesting story you have come up with.
Getting rid of me with these false accusations as you strengthen yourself using the death and destruction all this would cause.
How easy would it be for the strengthened you gain to take on the remaining two, who are already weakened due to our battle and a broken balance?
I didn’t expect someone like you to come up with a scheme like this.
I can see why the Universe would choose you. You hid yourself well, Darkness."

chapters.title: Chapter 1937: Stop.
paragraphs: "That’s an interesting story you have come up with.
Getting rid of me with these false accusations as you strengthen yourself using the death and destruction all this would cause,
How easy would it be for the strengthened you to take on the remaining two, who are already weakened due to our battle and a broken balance.
I didn’t expect someone like you to come up with a scheme like this,
I can see why the Universe would choose you,
You hid yourself well, Darkness."
The Entity of Light spoke in a calm voice, instantly redirecting all the blame onto Malice.
"Heh, you don’t really think they will believe your ridiculous assumptions, do you?"
Malice laughed condescendingly.
The Entity of Light, on the other hand, stayed silent.
It already knew the effect its words had.
Malice, the Entity of Darkness, then turned towards Eternity and Balance and,
"You two, we need to get rid of him before he gets strong enough to destroy us."
Darkness was raring to go.
After all, it had never liked Light in the first place. The two of them were destined enemies, and now that the Universe had chosen Light, Darkness had the perfect excuse to get rid of it.
But...
Balance and Eternity stayed silent.
And Darkness, who sensed this silence, realized what was happening.
"You... You two believe Light..."
"We have no reason to believe any of you."
Eternity answered honestly.
"What...?"
"We cannot afford to make a mistake here. We will only act once we are absolutely sure."
Balance nodded as well.
"Have you two lost your minds? We need to act with haste and get rid of Light. We cannot let Light grow!"
Again, Eternity and Balance stayed silent, and this time, Darkness didn’t push forward either.
It couldn’t be too desperate, else it would only attract more suspicion. Not to mention, Balance and Eternity were correct—they couldn’t trust it unless proven otherwise.
Not just Light, it could be Eternity or Balance too.
And if it was one of them, then getting rid of Light, even if it is its destined enemy, would be bad.
Every single entity present here has been alive for a long, long time. They knew all sorts of tricks, manipulations, and deceptions. If one of them was lying, there was no way to know for sure.
Once again, the Universe was playing the same game.
Using the Four of them to do what it wanted them to do. Now, the four of them would continuously suspect each other, giving the Universe’s chosen time to hide and grow.
In the end, the entire room turned silent as the four entities stared at each other.
"There is no point in any more conversations."
In the end, Eternity shook its head.
It already knew this was going to happen. It just hoped... it did not.
"Can’t you use your Law to see who amongst us is the Universe’s Chosen?"
Darkness suggested.
"And burn my True Essence? Again?"
Suddenly, Eternity’s tone shifted.
The incomprehensible light that couldn’t be understood suddenly materialized into an extremely handsome man with features so sharp that even the most loyal woman would fall for him if he wanted to.
Right now, however, the man looked... displeased.
"First, it was my Mother, who sacrificed herself to stop Chaosveil before it became too fast, and now you want me to do the same thing again?
And for what?
For you three to once again take advantage of my weakened world like you did after my mother died?
Do not think for a second that we have forgotten what you did. Our people and my World still haven’t recovered from everything you did."
Balance and Light were silent at those words.
But Darkness...
The Entity of Malice flickered, taking a human-like shape, becoming something Nux would recognize very quickly.
Yes, it was the same entity that broke the Necrocore and destroyed Umbrasol.
Darkness then glanced at Eternity and smirked,
"The aggression you show is quite uncharacteristic. It is almost as if you are trying to give yourself away.
What is it, Eternity?
Are you... the Universe’s Chosen?"
Eternity, however, simply narrowed his eyes and,
"If I was, you wouldn’t be alive."
"Oh?"
Darkness raised his eyebrows, his grin widening even further.
"I didn’t know you hated me. I spared your lives, didn’t I?"
"As if you were strong enough to kill me."
Eternity snorted.
"Oh? You have gotten much bolder, haven’t you, child? You weren’t like this when you had to hand over your greatest invention to me.
I miss that adorable child you were back then."
"Heh."
At that provocation, Eternity just laughed.
"Just as one would expect from someone like you, to think you still believe it was our greatest invention even after millions of years have passed."
"What...?"
Darkness narrowed his eyes, and this time, Eternity’s grin widened.
"Have you still not put it together? Did you truly believe what we gave you that day was our greatest invention?

It was just something we created to fool you. How else do you think your creators were able to recreate our technology within five hundred thousand years? As if you people are that capable. Even a fifty-thousand-year-old child from my World is better than your greatest inventor."
"Ah, this brings back memories. I miss that foolish brute you were back then. Oh wait,
You still are the same."
Eternity laughed.
"What? Are you going to attack me?"
Eternity smiled.
"Don’t think this would end the same way as it did back then. I am not the same as I was back then."
"We will find that out soon enough."
Darkness stepped forward, the malicious energy surrounding his body growing stronger and stronger.
Eternity didn’t back down either, but before things could go even further,
"Stop."
Light called out.
What once was just a calming energy bound together suddenly turned into a woman so beautiful that no words could correctly describe her beauty.
"We do not know who the Chosen is, but we will be giving him what he wants if we face each other.
Calm down."

sentences.text: "That’s an interesting story you have come up with.
Getting rid of me with these false accusations as you strengthen yourself using the death and destruction all this would cause,
How easy would it be for the strengthened you to take on the remaining two, who are already weakened due to our battle and a broken balance.
I didn’t expect someone like you to come up with a scheme like this,
I can see why the Universe would choose you,
You hid yourself well, Darkness."
The Entity of Light spoke in a calm voice, instantly redirecting all the blame onto Malice.
"Heh, you don’t really think they will believe your ridiculous assumptions, do you?"
Malice laughed condescendingly.
The Entity of Light, on the other hand, stayed silent.
It already knew the effect its words had.
Malice, the Entity of Darkness, then turned towards Eternity and Balance and,
"You two, we need to get rid of him before he gets strong enough to destroy us."
Darkness was raring to go.
After all, it had never liked Light in the first place.
The two of them were destined enemies, and now that the Universe had chosen Light, Darkness had the perfect excuse to get rid of it.
But...
Balance and Eternity stayed silent.
And Darkness, who sensed this silence, realized what was happening.
"You...
You two believe Light..."
"We have no reason to believe any of you."
Eternity answered honestly.
"What...?"
"We cannot afford to make a mistake here.
We will only act once we are absolutely sure."
Balance nodded as well.
"Have you two lost your minds?
We need to act with haste and get rid of Light.
We cannot let Light grow!"
Again, Eternity and Balance stayed silent, and this time, Darkness didn’t push forward either.
It couldn’t be too desperate, else it would only attract more suspicion.
Not to mention, Balance and Eternity were correct—they couldn’t trust it unless proven otherwise.
Not just Light, it could be Eternity or Balance too.
And if it was one of them, then getting rid of Light, even if it is its destined enemy, would be bad.
Every single entity present here has been alive for a long, long time.
They knew all sorts of tricks, manipulations, and deceptions.
If one of them was lying, there was no way to know for sure.
Once again, the Universe was playing the same game.
Using the Four of them to do what it wanted them to do.
Now, the four of them would continuously suspect each other, giving the Universe’s chosen time to hide and grow.
In the end, the entire room turned silent as the four entities stared at each other.
"There is no point in any more conversations."
In the end, Eternity shook its head.
It already knew this was going to happen.
It just hoped... it did not.
"Can’t you use your Law to see who amongst us is the Universe’s Chosen?"
Darkness suggested.
"And burn my True Essence?
Again?"
Suddenly, Eternity’s tone shifted.
The incomprehensible light that couldn’t be understood suddenly materialized into an extremely handsome man with features so sharp that even the most loyal woman would fall for him if he wanted to.
Right now, however, the man looked... displeased.
"First, it was my Mother, who sacrificed herself to stop Chaosveil before it became too fast, and now you want me to do the same thing again?
And for what?
For you three to once again take advantage of my weakened world like you did after my mother died?
Do not think for a second that we have forgotten what you did.
Our people and my World still haven’t recovered from everything you did."
Balance and Light were silent at those words.
But Darkness...
The Entity of Malice flickered, taking a human-like shape, becoming something Nux would recognize very quickly.
Yes, it was the same entity that broke the Necrocore and destroyed Umbrasol.
Darkness then glanced at Eternity and smirked,
"The aggression you show is quite uncharacteristic.
It is almost as if you are trying to give yourself away.
What is it, Eternity?
Are you... the Universe’s Chosen?"
Eternity, however, simply narrowed his eyes and,
"If I was, you wouldn’t be alive."
"Oh?"
Darkness raised his eyebrows, his grin widening even further.
"I didn’t know you hated me.
I spared your lives, didn’t I?"
"As if you were strong enough to kill me."
Eternity snorted.
"Oh?
You have gotten much bolder, haven’t you, child?
You weren’t like this when you had to hand over your greatest invention to me.
I miss that adorable child you were back then."
"Heh."
At that provocation, Eternity just laughed.
"Just as one would expect from someone like you, to think you still believe it was our greatest invention even after millions of years have passed."
"What...?"
Darkness narrowed his eyes, and this time, Eternity’s grin widened.
"Have you still not put it together?
Did you truly believe what we gave you that day was our greatest invention?
It was just something we created to fool you.
How else do you think your creators were able to recreate our technology within five hundred thousand years?
As if you people are that capable.
Even a fifty-thousand-year-old child from my World is better than your greatest inventor."
"Ah, this brings back memories.
I miss that foolish brute you were back then.
Oh wait,
You still are the same."
Eternity laughed.
"What?
Are you going to attack me?"
Eternity smiled.
"Don’t think this would end the same way as it did back then.
I am not the same as I was back then."
"We will find that out soon enough."
Darkness stepped forward, the malicious energy surrounding his body growing stronger and stronger.
Eternity didn’t back down either, but before things could go even further,
"Stop."
Light called out.
What once was just a calming energy bound together suddenly turned into a woman so beautiful that no words could correctly describe her beauty.
"We do not know who the Chosen is, but we will be giving him what he wants if we face each other.
Calm down."

chapters.title: Chapter 1938 Tsk.
paragraphs: "We do not know who the Chosen is, but we will be giving him what he wants if we face each other.
Calm down."
Light spoke, and Darkness grinned knowingly.
"Aren't you just saying this because you know you will be weakened if another war breaks out?"
"Do you not think of the consequences of your actions?"
Light questioned with a light frown.
"That is what the weak do."
Darkness smirked.
"Alright then, go ahead and do whatever you want."
Light shrugged. She, however, momentarily glanced at Balance, who still hadn't moved yet. It wasn't something she was going to miss.
"Have we tested each other enough?"
Suddenly, Eternity spoke up.
He had had enough of this sick game, especially when he knew nothing was going to come out of it.
"I'll be keeping an eye on all three of you. The moment I notice something out of the expected, I will call another meeting."
"What if you simply push the blame on one of us while you were the Chosen One all along?"
Darkness questioned. Eternity, however, simply stared at him and disappeared, not wanting to interact with him any further.
Balance did the same and disappeared.
The only ones in the room were now Light and Darkness.
"I really hope the Universe chose you."
Darkness smiled.
"At least that would make you somewhat interesting to defeat."
At those words, Light smiled back.
"I could never figure you out, huh..."
Saying those words, the Entity of Light disappeared.
In the end, Darkness left the room as well.
And just like that,
The Four Strongest Entities in the world now stood against each other, this time, with no possibility of them working together, not unless they figured out who amongst them the Universe had chosen.
Back in Yrniel, Nux and his wives lay in a garden, staring at the crimson glow in the sky that was slowly fading away.
They, however, weren't the only ones here. The rest of the Progenitors were there as well.
"The Sector has become much more unstable,"
Saphira reported.

"After the destruction of the Middle-Level Worlds that led the Crimson Convent Faction, the enemy faction took over the entire Sector. Just like other Lower-Level Worlds, we surrendered to them as well and agreed to pay the tribute they demanded.

However, in these past few months, the Lower-Level Worlds that were part of the enemy faction before requested that they wanted tribute from us as well. This matter is now being discussed, and if the Faction Leaders agree, the tribute we have to pay would become absurd, making it difficult for Yrniel to function.
We need to send someone to attend the meeting and convince them not to go through with this."
The Dragon Progenitor spoke as she glanced at Aeliana, who lay on the ground, showing no reaction whatsoever.

"I would have gone myself or sent another Progenitor, but we have decided to hide our existence in case something happens in the future. There is also a chance that someone will bring up the matter regarding our secret weapon, so we need someone who understands all this—"
"Stop it."
Before the Dragon Progenitor could continue, Amaya spoke up.
"She's not listening."
Seraphina turned silent, not knowing what to say.
Azriel's death shocked her. Not just her, all the Progenitors were shaken. They had relied on him for almost all their lives. What Azriel had done for them, what he had... lost for their sakes...
It was a burden on their hearts that they couldn't lift.
This was also the reason that when little Aeliana was left alone, all the Progenitors came together to raise her. They saw this as a way to pay back some of their debts.
However, as time passed, they grew more and more attached to the little child. The Progenitors, who had been deprived of a child's love for such a long time, finally felt... loved.

Aeliana became their ray of light. Raising her was no longer a matter of paying Azriel back. Every single one of them treated her like their own daughter and did everything in their power to keep a smile on her face all the time.
It had come to the point where Aeliana's mood decided the Progenitors'.
A sad Aeliana would make all the Progenitors sad, and a happy one would make them happy.
And now...
Seeing Aeliana like... this...
The Progenitors felt... weak.

After all, they couldn't think of anything to get the Vampire back to normal. Usually, every time Aeliana was depressed, she would bury herself in work and not think about it, but now, even that wasn't working.
The only one who could do something was Nux, and right now...
Even he was silent.
His mind was considering millions of possible future scenarios, ways to take down that woman who hurt his wife.
After all, as someone who knew Aeliana the most, he already knew no words or actions could alleviate the pain she was feeling.
The only thing they could do right now was stay next to her.
And that is what Nux did. He simply sat on the ground, allowing Aeliana to place her head on his lap while he, ever so gently, played with her hair, trying to calm her mind, not that it was working.
The Vampire was not showing any reaction.
But then,
"Tsk."
A snort was heard.
A sound that the Vampire reacted to, quite strongly at that.
She sat up and looked around desperately, even wondering if her mind was playing tricks on her. However, the moment she noticed Nux staring in a certain direction, she knew she wasn't mistaken.
"I told you to take care of my daughter, and this is how you are doing it?"
A voice was heard as suddenly, a being materialized right in front of them.
A being they all recognized in an instant. A being whose appearance made them widen their eyes in shock, and... a being who...
"FATHER!!"
A being who Aeliana had been thinking about all this while!

chapters.title: Chapter 1939 I became the Universe’s Child
paragraphs: "I told you to take care of my daughter, and this is how you are doing this?"
Azriel snorted as he stared at the man in front of him with his usual annoyed expression.
He wanted to bash his son-in-law even further, but before he could do so,
"FATHER!!"
A black rocket shot towards him and barged right into his chest, throwing him on the ground together with her.
"Uggghhh!!"
Azriel groaned in pain.
Aeliana, however, completely ignored that and hugged her father as tightly as she could, as if afraid he would disappear again.
Azriel squinted his eyes as his mouth twitched, he, however, quickly controlled his expression and forced a smile on his face.
Then, he gently patted his daughter's head.
"I am ba—"
Flicker
However, before the Vampire Progenitor could even say something, Aeliana disappeared.
Both father and daughter frowned in confusion.
Aeliana, who reappeared next to Nux, tried to rush towards her father again, but Nux grabbed her hand.
"Wait."
He called out as his eyes fell on Azriel, who was still lying on the ground.
"Nux, what are you doing?"
Aeliana questioned, her confusion and slight frustration couldn't remain hidden. Nux, however, ignored her and continued to observe Azriel, who still hadn't stood up.
"What happened?"
Nux questioned as he squinted his eyes.
Azriel frowned, and seeing his reaction, Nux grinned.
"So your spine still hasn't regenerated, huh...
What's your current level?
Beginner Stage Cultivator?
Or...
Are you just a mortal right now?"
Nux questioned directly, and everyone present widened their eyes in disbelief.
"What...?"
Aeliana couldn't believe what she was hearing.
She quickly turned towards her father, trying to see through his cultivation, but just like usual, she sensed nothing.
Soon, however, she noticed something different.
Unlike before...
Her father didn't feel... absolute.
When she couldn't sense his cultivation, it wasn't because he was too strong for her to see through, it was because...
He was too weak.
His cultivation... everything he had worked so hard for...
It all disappeared.
Nux then waved his hand, and a golden energy enveloped Azriel, but before he could heal him,
"Stop."
Azriel ordered him to stop, and Nux did as he was told.
Azriel then glanced at one of the Elven Progenitors and nodded at her.

The Progenitor, who realized what he wanted, was momentarily surprised, unable to believe what was happening. However, she didn't let that confuse her and quickly healed Azriel, allowing him to stand.
The Vampire Progenitor dusted off his clothes, and Nux, who continued to observe him, noted another thing.
"Yrniel isn't reacting to you."
Azriel was the closest being to Yrniel. For the world that mourned his death for weeks to not even react to his return...
Something didn't add up.
"It is angry."
Azriel replied with a wry smile.
"What does that mean?"
Nux questioned with a frown on his face.
"I am no longer part of Yrniel. My connection to it no longer exists."
"What...?"
Aeliana blinked in surprise.
Faustina, on the other hand, frowned in confusion.
"That doesn't make sense. I can still sense your connection to Yrniel,
And if you were a foreign entity, your arrival would have alerted us, and that didn't happen."
Azriel chuckled at those words.
"My entire existence doesn't make sense, Faus."
He stared at the Human Progenitor and,
"I abandoned all my Blood Essence that was created out of Yrniel's Energy. You should know what that means."
Faustina turned silent, unable to retort those words.
"Father...
What happened?"
Aeliana questioned, her face full of worry. At the same time, Nux sealed the space around him, making sure no one could eavesdrop on their conversation.
"I was chosen by the Universe."
Azriel revealed, and the moment he mentioned those words, everyone around him frowned.
"What...?"
Nux questioned.
Faustina questioned.
This was the first time he was hearing of this.
"I became the Universe's Child."
"Is this... similar to being Yrniel's Child?"
Faustina questioned.
"Indeed."
Azriel nodded.
"I was Yrniel's Child before, and after my connection with Yrniel was broken, I became the Universe's Child."
"Wait..."
Nux suddenly frowned.
"If you became the Universe's Child, does it mean...?"
"Yes, I formed a special connection with the Universe's Will."
"What...?"
Nux and the others widened their eyes in disbelief.
"So you saw the Universe's Will."
"I did. I believe that is what saved my life."
"But... why?"
Nux frowned.
He didn't like where this was going.
And as if knowing exactly what he was thinking, Azriel smiled as he questioned back,
"Why do you think?"
Nux's face turned grimmer as he heard those words.
He was right.
The Universe chose Azriel to...
"To deal with the Anomaly."
"Indeed."
Azriel nodded, his smile widening even further, while Nux and his wives' faces became much, much grimmer.
In an instant, the tension rose up. Nux's wives narrowed their eyes as they looked around. The Progenitors did the same. After all, deep down, everyone knew that the instant something happened,
Nux's wives would side with him while the Progenitors would side with Azriel.
The problem, however, was Aeliana and Faustina.
Especially Aeliana.
If her father and husband stood against each other... she didn't know who she would choose...
Heck, just the thought of having to make a choice broke her heart into pieces.
But then,
"The Universe chose you to deal with me?
How dumb."
Nux laughed, instantly easing up, as if all the tension he felt was disappearing.
Azriel smiled as well.
In an instant, the tension in the air eased up like it never existed. Aeliana glanced at Nux with hopeful eyes, and Nux chuckled at that.
"Of course nothing's going to happen.
Do you really think your father and I would fight and put you through the pain of choosing one of us?"
Aeliana lowered her head in embarrassment.
Nux smiled as he placed her head on his chest, patting her head, instantly calming her racing heart.
"You made that fox choose."
Azriel laughed.
"She wasn't my wife.
My wives have special privileges."

The Devourer then glanced at Azriel and questioned directly,

"The Universe chose you to stop Nux. If you two don't go against each other and Nux continues to devour what belongs to the Universe as he is doing right now, wouldn't it put your position in jeopardy?
The Universe saved your life. I highly doubt it doesn't have the means to take it away. If Nux continues to act as he pleases, won't the Universe target you instead?
Or do you want Nux to back down?"
Once again, the atmosphere shifted.
This time, the ones who were tense were Nux's wives, especially the ones he hadn't taken into his Universe yet.
If Nux was forced to back down because of Azriel...
Wouldn't this mean they would never be connected to him?
They couldn't accept this.
No, more than that, they knew Nux would never accept it.
The women turned towards Nux, who, instead of showing any reaction, was staring at Azriel.
"My wives are losing their minds, Father-in-Law.
So stop with the games and get on with it.
What's the plan?
Why did you come here?"

Nux wasn't sure what the Universe was planning, and honestly, he didn't care. After all, he knew what sort of man his Father-in-Law was. He knew Azriel would never truly go against him because of how much he loved his daughter.
The very fact that he was here after being chosen as the Universe's Protector told him that he had come with a plan.
A middle ground where both of them could get what they wanted.
After all, this was the type of beings the two of them were.
They didn't make choices; they grabbed what they wanted or died trying.
And Nux was correct.
The Vampire Progenitor had a plan.
"Do you not see how weak I have gotten?"
He questioned.
"How am I supposed to stop the Anomaly when I am in this state?"
"So that's your play?"
Nux raised his eyebrow, impressed.
"Devour your wives' connection with the Universe."
Azriel ordered.
"And don't do it inside the Reaper's Veil.
Do it right here.
Challenge the Universe by targeting the people of its Protector's previous world. Oh, and while you are at it,
Devour these old bastards too. They have fed off Yrniel for far too long. It is time they became somewhat useful."
Nux's expression changed.
"You want me to devour everyone?"
"You have enough spots, don't you?"
Azriel questioned back.
"I do."
"Then what's with the questioning? Do what I tell you to.
Or have you grown an extra pair of balls just because I have become somewhat weaker than before?"
"Come on, Father-in-Law. You know it is not like that."
Nux smiled at those words.
"I've always had an extra pair of balls. Your strength never mattered."
Everyone turned silent. Inwardly, however, everyone nodded at those words. After all, this brat went against Azriel when he was merely a Saint.
When had he ever shown restraint?
If anything, he had become somewhat calmer compared to the troublemaker he was before.
Azriel, however, was unamused.
He simply stared at Nux with an expressionless look on his face, and Nux felt his body tremble.
For some reason, his Father-in-Law's gaze still felt intimidating.
"Alright, alright, I'll do what you say."
He nodded.
"But are you sure the Universe wouldn't target Yrniel if I do that?"
Nux questioned one last time.
He was getting what he so desperately wanted just like that. It all felt... underwhelming.
His mind was full of doubts and questions.
What if something went wrong?
Azriel, however, just waved his hand in dismissal.
"The Universe won't react to your actions anymore.
It has given that authority to me."
He revealed nonchalantly.
"What...?
Does this mean... you can destroy worlds using the Universe's power now...?"
"Yes. Now, would you get to what I told you to do and stop annoying me?"
Azriel nodded as if it wasn't a big deal.
For the first time in his life, Nux realized why people hated him every time he did something absurd and dismissed the matter as if it wasn't a big deal.
His mouth twitched without stop as he stared at his Father-in-Law. Then, he asked another question,
"Does this mean you can get rid of the Supreme Worlds too?"
"I can."
Azriel nodded.
"But it's not easy. The Supreme Worlds are closest to the Universe. If I wish to destroy them, I need a strong reason.
Not that it matters. It is only a matter of time before I become strong enough to deal with them on my own."
The Vampire Progenitor shrugged.
"What does that mean?"
Nux narrowed his eyes.
He was used to Azriel's arrogance, but this time, something felt different...
It was as if... he was missing something.
Something this man wasn't telling him.
And hearing his question, Azriel grinned.
"I am no longer connected to Yrniel."
"Yes, I know that. It also means you are free to move, even when you regain all your powers."
Nux nodded. Azriel, however, shook his head.
"That is not it."
"The Universe chose me. My Blood Essence, which was once connected with Yrniel, is now connected with the very Universe."
"And what does that mean...?"
"It means that I am not part of Yrniel's cultivation bridge anymore,
I now walk on the Universe's Cultivation Bridge.
Meaning that the restrictions that have been placed on me by the Universe have now been released,
I have no limits,
I can grow as much as I want, just like you."
The Vampire Progenitor's grin widened even further as he stared at his son-in-law and,
"The race is on, brat.
And this time, it will be much fairer."

chapters.title: Chapter 1941 This is the only way out.
paragraphs: "The race is on, brat.
And this time, it will be much fairer."
Azriel's grin widened as he stared at Nux.
Nux blinked in surprise. Not just him, everyone around him was the same.
"The Universe's Cultivation Bridge...?"
Aeliana muttered, a little lost.
After all, these words sounded so... grand.
If her father could now grow as much as he wanted, then...
Wouldn't he become the strongest?
After all, unlike Nux, who still had to figure out a way to get stronger as he climbed the stage, her father knew everything, all the way to the Infinity Stage.

Sure, he was walking on a different Cultivation Bridge, but that didn't change anything. After all, the said Bridge still belonged to the Universe. It would be familiar, if not similar, to Yrniel's Cultivation Bridge.
The speed at which someone like Azriel would understand it couldn't even be predicted.
This was nothing more than giving a man, who was already the strongest, a straight path to greatness.
A path that would turn him into a True Absolute, a being no one in this Universe could stand up against.
"So the Universe was that desperate, huh..."
Nux chuckled as he stared at Azriel.
Instead of being intimidated or pressured by Azriel's words, he just grinned at him.
"You see, it has been a while since I have encountered someone I can call a rival. No, actually, I have never encountered a rival."
"What a coincidence."
Azriel grinned as well.
"But don't worry, child. You still do not have a rival.
After all, being rivals means to go back and forth, to sometimes win and sometimes lose against each other while pushing each other to greatness, but...
For the two of us, it would be different.
You may feel pressured to get stronger right now and stay ahead of me, but the instant I surpass you, the difference between us will be so big that you will simply give up.
We will never be rivals, Nux Leander.
I will always be better."
"Funny how the one saying it is a mortal without any cultivation."
Nux chuckled.
Azriel, however, just shook his head and grinned even more.
"Who said I am a mortal?
I understood the new Cultivation Bridge while I was coming here and broke through to become somewhat equivalent to a Beginner Stage Cultivator."
"You are a Beginner Stage Cultivator?"
Nux raised his eyebrow.
"I do not sense anything."
Dagahra commented.
"Of course, you do not.
None of you even understand the Universal Energy. How can you sense it?"
"Wait, you mean..."
"Yes, I cultivate the most abundantly found energy in the Universe, the energy that is always growing, the energy with no limits, the energy that can be found anywhere in this Universe,
The Universal Energy."
Azriel revealed, still staring at Nux with a smile.
It felt oddly satisfying to finally stand up against this annoying man who was always the one with the highest potential in the room.
Yes, since the very start, Azriel knew Nux was someone who would surpass him eventually, but now, things were different.
Now, it was his turn to surpass Nux.
"Wait, is this the reason I still sense your connection to Yrniel?"
Faustina suddenly questioned, and Azriel nodded.
"I now represent the Universe. I have a connection to every world."
"And what about the Supreme Worlds?"
Suddenly, Nux questioned.
"I presume they wouldn't take kindly to the existence of a Universe's Child. What if they come find you?"
"They would try that, indeed."
"And it wouldn't exactly be easy to hide Yrniel's existence either. After what I did before, this Sector would already be under their eyes.

And once Yrniel absorbs all this energy, the cultivators here would become much stronger than before. Eventually, it would raise suspicions, and once it does, those Supreme Worlds would definitely look into it.
It wouldn't take more than a thousand years. Actually, this might happen even faster, considering everything that is happening in the Sector.

Those Middle-Level Worlds might come after us. If we do not do something, more suspicions would rise, and with how desperate those Supreme Worlds must be right now, they would definitely hear about it.
How do you plan to deal with that?"
Nux asked a series of questions, and Azriel's expression turned serious as well.

After all, they may be rivals, but in the end, they both knew they were in this together. Their enemies were the same. Not to mention, their connection with Aeliana made it absolutely impossible for them to go against each other.
"Why do you think I want you to devour all your wives and these old things right now?"
Azriel questioned.
"What do you mean?"
Nux frowned.
"I have already thought of the use for all that energy Yrniel has gotten."
"What is it?"
"Yrniel will create the shield, for the third time."
"What...?"
Nux blinked in surprise.
Not just him, the rest of the people present here were the same.
"You want Yrniel to use all this energy to create a Third Shield?"
Faustina frowned.
"No, not all of it, just enough for the shield to last another 20,000 years. That is all the time I need to return to my previous power level.
It would take about half of the energy I returned to it, and even after using it, Yrniel would still be as strong as a weaker High-Level World."
Faustina tried to counter. Azriel, however, shook his head.
"Faus, this is the only way out."
Silence fell over until, a few seconds later, Nux nodded.
"I agree."
"What...?"
Felberta called out.
After all, she knew what raising the shield meant.
Nux stared at her and shook his head.
"As Lord Azriel said, we have no other way out.
Yrniel needs to create another shield so it disappears from Outer Space's eyes and stops attracting attention.
It would be like it was destroyed, and even the Supreme World wouldn't be able to link Lord Azriel to Yrniel.
Not just that,
If Yrniel is gone and its safety is absolutely assured, we wouldn't have anything holding us back either.
It would allow us to truly go all out since we would have nothing to worry about."
Felberta lowered her head, and,
"It would also mean that we wouldn't be able to return here either."

chapters.title: Chapter 1942 Nux was now free to do whatever he pleased.
paragraphs: "But...
It would also mean that we wouldn't be able to return here either."
Felberta lowered her head and spoke in a low tone.
Yes, since none of them were connected to Yrniel, they wouldn't be able to sense it either, just like how they could not sense newborn worlds that were still protected by their shields.
It would also mean that...
For 20,000 years, Felberta wouldn't be able to meet her son and his family either.
It wasn't just her. Melia, Aisha, Eisheth, Rune, Lyriana, and Aeliana wouldn't be able to meet people they were close to either.
And honestly...
Almost none of them knew if the people they loved would be alive after 20,000 years had passed and Yrniel became visible again.
This time, however, Nux turned silent.

This was a choice they had to make. Yrniel had already attracted too much attention. There was no other way to protect it, especially with Azriel now weakened and being chased by the strongest force in the Universe.
"Enough."
Soon, however, Amaya called out as she glanced at the women around her.
"Stop weeping. Nobody's dying. You just won't see them for 20,000 years, what's the big deal? Isn't it better than seeing them dead?"
"What do you mean nobody's dying...?"
Felberta questioned with a frown.
"Did you forget? Lord Azriel told Nux to devour everyone. How many more people do you think he needs to become a Primordial?"
The instant Amaya asked this question, Felberta's expression changed.
"And Primordials live for 25,000 years..."
"Exactly."
Amaya nodded.
"Once Nux is a Primordial, he could strengthen everyone and make them a Primordial. They probably wouldn't have Absolute Laws, but they would still be able to survive for 20,000 years.
And who knows?
Some of them might even break through to the Transcendent Stage.
So stop weeping, no one's dying.
Go meet the people you cherish, spend some time with them. You have..."
Amaya turned towards Azriel, wanting to know how long they had.
"A month."
Azriel answered.
"And what about those Middle-Level Worlds?"
Saphira questioned.
"It doesn't matter. Pay the tribute they desire. We won't be seeing them after this anyway."
Amaya shrugged nonchalantly.
The devourer then quickly got next to Nux and,
"Now shoo, shoo, everyone, go spend time with the people you love~"
The wives, who were about to leave, felt their mouths twitching at those words. They, however, controlled themselves and disappeared.
Nux, on the other hand, tightly grabbed Amaya, but very quickly,
The rest of the women, who didn't care about anything else, surrounded him, wanting attention, and Nux couldn't be happier to indulge them.
Azriel, who saw this sight, turned towards his daughter and,
"Are you sure you wish to leave? You will be seeing me even after Yrniel is gone, you know?"
He spoke, and Aeliana nodded with a light smile on her face.
"The Ancestral Order has always been like a family to me. There are people I love there, and I do not wish to go without saying my goodbyes.
There are also those Middle-Level Worlds. While giving the tribute is an option, I will try to avoid that.
I have been lazy for the past few weeks. It is about time I get to work."
The Vampire spoke as she gently held her father's hand, feeling a strange sense of safety and comfort despite now being stronger than him.
Azriel stared at his daughter and smiled, tightening his hold on her hand.
"I thought you would want to spend time with that brat."
He spoke as he stared at Nux and his wives. However, as he turned back to his daughter, he just saw her smirking at those women and,
"Heh, they can try to hog him all they want.
In the end,
He will be mine and mine alone."
The Vampire's crimson eyes darkened. It was a look that took Azriel aback.
A look he had seen before... in Nux's eyes.
The same, almost unsettling eyes that made the Vampire Progenitor worried.
Soon, however, that look disappeared as Aeliana turned towards Azriel and smiled again.
"Let's go."
She muttered, and the Vampire Progenitor nodded.
The rest of the Progenitors decided to leave as well. Now, the only ones left were Nux and his wives.
And how did they decide to spend this month?
"Edda."
Nux called out, and very quickly, they were in an illusion world where time flowed very, very differently.

A month passed by very quickly. The wives sent their goodbyes to their families and subordinates. Aeliana also convinced the Middle-Level Worlds to delay the tributes by three months, to which they agreed.
Yes, they were conned.
Not that the Vampire cared about it.
During this time, Azriel also broke through and became an Expert Stage Cultivator.

Almost all the time he needed was to understand the Cultivation Bridge. Once that was done, with the abundance of energy right outside Yrniel, the Vampire Progenitor could cultivate without any worries.
Also, after spending two weeks with Aeliana, he had also moved away from Azriel.
After all, the Anomaly devouring people connected to Yrniel right when the supposed protector was there would obviously raise suspicions.
Anyways, right now, all of Nux's wives who weren't yet connected to him were gathered in one place.
Nux was planning on devouring all of them at the same time to make sure nothing went wrong.

Yes, Azriel did say the Universe wouldn't react, but even the Vampire Progenitor wasn't sure about it. After all, at his current level, he didn't have absolute power over the Universe's decisions like he did with Yrniel's.

The only thing he knew was that no matter what happened, the Universe wouldn't devour Yrniel because, one, Yrniel was a Pseudo Supreme-Level World that was close to the Universe; second, the Universe's Child, the current most important person to the Universe, had a connection to it.
"Alright."
Nux nodded, taking a deep breath as he stared at his wives with an excited smile.
It was finally time for all his wives to finally become his and his alone.

The Universe inside Nux was raring to go, wanting to devour what should have been his in the first place. Nux, who had been holding himself back all this while, continued to stare at his wives and then,
He let go.
BOOOOOM
In an instant, a vast amount of black energy was released from his body, enveloping the women's bodies and instantly devouring their connection with Yrniel and the Universe.
And...
Just as Azriel said,
The Universe didn't react.
Nux was now free to do whatever he pleased.

sentences.text: "But...
It would also mean that we wouldn't be able to return here either."
Felberta lowered her head and spoke in a low tone.
Yes, since none of them were connected to Yrniel, they wouldn't be able to sense it either, just like how they could not sense newborn worlds that were still protected by their shields.
It would also mean that...
For 20,000 years, Felberta wouldn't be able to meet her son and his family either.
It wasn't just her.
Melia, Aisha, Eisheth, Rune, Lyriana, and Aeliana wouldn't be able to meet people they were close to either.
And honestly...
Almost none of them knew if the people they loved would be alive after 20,000 years had passed and Yrniel became visible again.
This time, however, Nux turned silent.
This was a choice they had to make.
Yrniel had already attracted too much attention.
There was no other way to protect it, especially with Azriel now weakened and being chased by the strongest force in the Universe.
"Enough."
Soon, however, Amaya called out as she glanced at the women around her.
"Stop weeping.
Nobody's dying.
You just won't see them for 20,000 years, what's the big deal?
Isn't it better than seeing them dead?"
"What do you mean nobody's dying...?"
Felberta questioned with a frown.
"Did you forget?
Lord Azriel told Nux to devour everyone.
How many more people do you think he needs to become a Primordial?"
The instant Amaya asked this question, Felberta's expression changed.
"And Primordials live for 25,000 years..."
"Exactly."
Amaya nodded.
"Once Nux is a Primordial, he could strengthen everyone and make them a Primordial.
They probably wouldn't have Absolute Laws, but they would still be able to survive for 20,000 years.
And who knows?
Some of them might even break through to the Transcendent Stage.
So stop weeping, no one's dying.
Go meet the people you cherish, spend some time with them.
You have..."
Amaya turned towards Azriel, wanting to know how long they had.
"A month."
Azriel answered.
"And what about those Middle-Level Worlds?"
Saphira questioned.
"It doesn't matter.
Pay the tribute they desire.
We won't be seeing them after this anyway."
Amaya shrugged nonchalantly.
The devourer then quickly got next to Nux and,
"Now shoo, shoo, everyone, go spend time with the people you love~"
The wives, who were about to leave, felt their mouths twitching at those words.
They, however, controlled themselves and disappeared.
Nux, on the other hand, tightly grabbed Amaya, but very quickly,
The rest of the women, who didn't care about anything else, surrounded him, wanting attention, and Nux couldn't be happier to indulge them.
Azriel, who saw this sight, turned towards his daughter and,
"Are you sure you wish to leave?
You will be seeing me even after Yrniel is gone, you know?"
He spoke, and Aeliana nodded with a light smile on her face.
"The Ancestral Order has always been like a family to me.
There are people I love there, and I do not wish to go without saying my goodbyes.
There are also those Middle-Level Worlds.
While giving the tribute is an option, I will try to avoid that.
I have been lazy for the past few weeks.
It is about time I get to work."
The Vampire spoke as she gently held her father's hand, feeling a strange sense of safety and comfort despite now being stronger than him.
Azriel stared at his daughter and smiled, tightening his hold on her hand.
"I thought you would want to spend time with that brat."
He spoke as he stared at Nux and his wives.
However, as he turned back to his daughter, he just saw her smirking at those women and,
"Heh, they can try to hog him all they want.
In the end,
He will be mine and mine alone."
The Vampire's crimson eyes darkened.
It was a look that took Azriel aback.
A look he had seen before... in Nux's eyes.
The same, almost unsettling eyes that made the Vampire Progenitor worried.
Soon, however, that look disappeared as Aeliana turned towards Azriel and smiled again.
"Let's go."
She muttered, and the Vampire Progenitor nodded.
The rest of the Progenitors decided to leave as well.
Now, the only ones left were Nux and his wives.
And how did they decide to spend this month?
"Edda."
Nux called out, and very quickly, they were in an illusion world where time flowed very, very differently.
A month passed by very quickly.
The wives sent their goodbyes to their families and subordinates.
Aeliana also convinced the Middle-Level Worlds to delay the tributes by three months, to which they agreed.
Yes, they were conned.
Not that the Vampire cared about it.
During this time, Azriel also broke through and became an Expert Stage Cultivator.
Almost all the time he needed was to understand the Cultivation Bridge.
Once that was done, with the abundance of energy right outside Yrniel, the Vampire Progenitor could cultivate without any worries.
Also, after spending two weeks with Aeliana, he had also moved away from Azriel.
After all, the Anomaly devouring people connected to Yrniel right when the supposed protector was there would obviously raise suspicions.
Anyways, right now, all of Nux's wives who weren't yet connected to him were gathered in one place.
Nux was planning on devouring all of them at the same time to make sure nothing went wrong.
Yes, Azriel did say the Universe wouldn't react, but even the Vampire Progenitor wasn't sure about it.
After all, at his current level, he didn't have absolute power over the Universe's decisions like he did with Yrniel's.

The only thing he knew was that no matter what happened, the Universe wouldn't devour Yrniel because, one, Yrniel was a Pseudo Supreme-Level World that was close to the Universe; second, the Universe's Child, the current most important person to the Universe, had a connection to it.
"Alright."
Nux nodded, taking a deep breath as he stared at his wives with an excited smile.
It was finally time for all his wives to finally become his and his alone.
The Universe inside Nux was raring to go, wanting to devour what should have been his in the first place.
Nux, who had been holding himself back all this while, continued to stare at his wives and then,
He let go.
BOOOOOM
In an instant, a vast amount of black energy was released from his body, enveloping the women's bodies and instantly devouring their connection with Yrniel and the Universe.
And...
Just as Azriel said,
The Universe didn't react.
Nux was now free to do whatever he pleased.

chapters.title: Chapter 1943 Oh, come on, you had your time, didn’t you?
paragraphs: "Heh."
Nux laughed.
Staring at all his wives, standing inside his Universe, an ear-to-ear wide grin appeared on his face.
"Finally."
He muttered, his golden eyes shining with possessiveness so intense that it looked like he was about to lose his mind.
"Finally, all of you are mine and mine alone~"
He declared as the very fabric of space in his Universe trembled because of his intense emotions.
The women, who were on the receiving end of this show, smiled. Nux's possessiveness enveloped them all, and not a single one of them complained.

They just smiled, waiting for him to embrace them. Right now, their minds were at ease. Feeling Nux's emotions, feeling their connection to him, and best of all, having their very lives connected to his finally made them feel full.
They had finally gotten what they so desperately wanted.
"Alright, stop staring at each other like fools.
Nux, it is time to break through."
Shadow spoke up.
"That is right. We also need to sever the Progenitors. You need to become Primordial for that."
Felberta nodded.
Nux nodded back as he stared at Eisheth.
With a flick of his finger, the Succubi Queen was teleported right into his arms.
"I need to be as close to you as possible for this to work."
Nux spoke.
"Should I remove my clothes? That would allow us to get even closer~"
Eisheth chuckled.
"Stop trying to tempt me, demon.
I have things to do."
Nux controlled himself as he tightened his hug around his succubus.
"Never~"
Eisheth chuckled as she pressed her breasts onto Nux's chest. Obviously, the woman knew what she was doing, and Nux was enjoying every second of it.
Unable to control himself any further, he sealed the woman's lips and started sucking her upper lip as slowly as he could. It was as if he was savoring every moment of it.
The Succubus Queen didn't hold back either. She started sucking his lower lip at the same pace.

A single kiss was more than enough to make their lower bodies react to each other. The Succubus had succeeded. Right now, the only thing Nux could think about was grabbing her as tightly as possible and taking her inside a room.
However,
"Control yourself."
Aeliana spoke up with a strict look on her face.
"Yes, yes."
Nux pouted.
Then, he stared at Eisheth and devoured her cultivation.
"Annh~"
Eisheth moaned.
"I didn't even do anything!"
Nux complained.
"What? Can I not feel good? Or is your self-control so weak that even a single moan turns you on?"
The Succubus Queen chuckled as she seductively licked her lips. The woman had Nux wrapped all around her fingers.
Nux's mouth twitched, barely able to control himself.
Very quickly, he shook his head, getting rid of all these thoughts in his head. Then, he looked into Eisheth's eyes and,
"Are you prepared?"
He questioned.
"Of course~
Do whatever you want with me."
Eisheth smiled.
Nux, however, had steeled his mind, so he held on... barely.
'I'll get back to you, woman.'
He threatened.
His threat, however, was too weak for the previous Queen.
'I'll be waiting~'
"I will be reading your memories now."
Nux spoke, closing his eyes since he didn't want to see the woman right now.
Then, strange patterns appeared on his body as he started reading Eisheth's body to comprehend her Law.
The process lasted for a few seconds. Once he was done, he opened his eyes and raised his eyebrow.
"You are going to make things difficult for me."
He commented.
"What can I say? It is a habit. I like to remain the center of attention."
Nux just shook his head as he sealed the woman's lips again. She reciprocated the kiss.
Nux, on the other hand, used his saliva as the medium and raised her cultivation.
From a Mortal to Beginner, Advanced... King, Emperor... all the way to the Saint Stage.
Then, he looked into her eyes and,
"I really hate having to use saliva out of all my body fluids to raise your cultivation. It is such a waste."
"Well..."
Eisheth's hands moved, tracing Nux's body as they went down. But then,
"Oi.
We are waiting."
Aeliana jumped in again.
For some reason, seeing Nux standing with another woman bothered her much more than it normally did, especially after getting the memories, where she was his only one.
How wonderful it would be if she got rid of everyone here...
Yes, the Vampire's thoughts were getting into dangerous territory.
"Oh, come on, you had your time, didn't you?"
Eisheth complained.
"Don't think I don't know that you returned a week earlier to spend time with him.
You had your time as well.
People are waiting. We do not know how the Universe will react, and we also need to sever the Progenitors.
Time is not on our side, so make it quick."
Aeliana spoke, and surprisingly, the one who backed her up was her longtime enemy.
"She is correct.
We do not have all day. We have things to do."
Amaya spoke up, glaring at all the women, including Aeliana, with her dark, dangerously possessive eyes.
"This place is so crowded now. It was perfect when I was the only one here."
The first wife stepped in with a light smile on her face.
Amaya and Aeliana narrowed their eyes at those words, but just as the catfight was about to start,
"Form your Law."
Nux whispered into Eisheth's ear, and the Succubus nodded.
She released her aura as the energy of her Law gathered above her head, a much purer but similar energy gathered over Nux's head as well, attracting the women's attention.
Then, the two energies combined, forming a massive pool of energy that very quickly moved into Eisheth's body, instantly allowing her to break through and become a Complete Divine.
And not just any Divine...
"An Absolute Law..."
Eisheth muttered as she clenched her fists.
Indeed, she was now a Complete Divine with an Absolute Law.
And it wasn't just her who got stronger.
Nux was the same.
He was now even closer to breaking through.
With a big smile on his face, he glanced at his wives and,
"Next."
He called out.

chapters.title: Chapter 1944 Get away, bitch.
paragraphs: "It is finally my turn~"
Aeliana chuckled as she slowly walked towards her husband.
Nux, who saw her, smiled as well. He waved his hand, and just like the others, the Vampire was teleported into his arms.
"How impatient~"
Aeliana chuckled, leaning her body on his. It was the Vampire's way to tempt him.
And obviously, her trick was working.
Honestly, with how absolutely breathtaking the woman was, just her standing still was more than enough to tempt anyone.
"I have a difficult time holding back."
Nux spoke.
"That is not good. We would have to work on that."
Aeliana smiled.
"How about you use me as an outlet? Let all your desires out on me, and once it is all out of your system, you will be able to hold back in front of oth—"
"Ahem, keep it moving, lady. We do not have all day."
Before the Vampire could complete, Eisheth spoke up.
And she wasn't alone.
"Yes. Keep it moving. The Progenitors are waiting. You cannot take all the time."
"Indeed, indeed."
"Get on with it, woman!"
The rest of the women spoke up, teaming up against the Vampire.
Clearly, the Vampire had offended them all.
How?
Obviously, that doesn't need to be said.
"Yeah, keep it moving."
Amaya nodded with a grin as well.
Aeliana narrowed her eyes as she stared at the Devourer. She turned towards Nux and,
"Ignore them."
She ordered.
"Can I really...?"
Nux smiled weakly. He could still feel their piercing stares; even Skyla was staring at the two with those eyes.
"...Let's be quick."
In the end, Aeliana gave in.
Nux chuckled as he devoured the woman's cultivation.
Aeliana then closed her eyes, letting Nux read her memories.
"I will now know everything about you~"
Nux teased.
"You already do."
The Vampire shrugged, not affected by those words.
In a few seconds, Nux opened his eyes, reading her memories and comprehending her Law.
Yes, just like the rest of his wives, he had now devoured Aeliana's Law too.
Obviously, since her Law was already perfect, he couldn't exactly strengthen it any further, so he just accepted Aeliana's Law.
He kissed the woman, and very quickly, she started sucking his blood.
Yes, with Melia and now Aeliana, the mode of energy transfer wasn't saliva; it was blood.
"Form your Law."
Once Aeliana was a Saint, Nux ordered. The woman nodded and closed her eyes, once again forming the same Law.

Yes, she did have a second chance, but she was already used to her Law and had found multiple ways to fight using it. She also realized that Nux needed someone with a Law like hers on his side, so she didn't change anything.
BOOOM
Aeliana then broke through to the Divine Stage.
And...
The Vampire wasn't the only one who broke through.
BOOOOOOOOOOOM
The entire Universe shook. All the energies, the Laws, the stars, and Umbrasol—everything trembled as Nux's Aura exploded, instantly suppressing everything around it.
Even though the women weren't directly affected because he made sure they weren't, they still felt his Aura and...
"This is absurd..."
Vyriana, who had appeared next to Aeliana, commented with a solemn look on her face.
"This is no Primordial..."
The Dragon commented.
"Well, we already expected something like this, didn't we?"
Aeliana chuckled at those words.
"We did, but..."
The Dragon had no words.
"To think two people are breaking through..."
She spoke as she turned towards Shadow, who, just like Nux, was breaking through.
"His Aura has completely overwhelmed hers."
"Technically, the source of those two Auras is the same, so it isn't surprising that her Aura is overshadowed."
Aeliana commented, her body still feeling the chills as she sensed the absurd amount of energy Nux was releasing.
The entire Universe seemed to have shaken to its very core. Every energy in here was becoming purer and purer and was rising in quality.
The process lasted for a good few minutes until all the energy Nux had released finally returned to his body and,
"Haaaahhh..."
He exhaled deeply and smiled at his wives.
Nux Leander was finally a Primordial.
"After so fucking long..."
He smiled. The rest of the women quickly surrounded him, but then,
"You aren't forgetting something, are you?"
Aeliana smiled, instantly attracting Nux's attention.
"Right."
Nux nodded. With a wave of his finger, Aeliana appeared in his arms again, and he sealed her lips.
Aeliana was a Primordial; she wouldn't have survived for long as a Divine, so he needed to raise her cultivation back to the Primordial Level.
Obviously, to do that, he needed to kiss the woman again and let her drink his blood, but...
Instead of drinking his blood, the Vampire continued to kiss him aggressively. Even her tongue had moved into his mouth while she had wrapped her entire body around him.
Yes, she was hogging Nux all for herself.
"This bitch..."
Amaya, who realized what she was doing, quickly moved to throw the perverted Vampire again.
Aeliana, however, slowed the time around all of them, wanting to keep Nux to herself a little longer.
But then, she felt a hand on her shoulder.
"Did you forget about me?"
The Dragon questioned.
Her power obviously had no effect on the Dragon since she was currently stronger than her.
"You can have your turn after me."
Aeliana bribed her friend, to which the Dragon agreed very quickly.
"What about me?"
The Heart of the Universe questioned.
"You after her."
The Vampire bribed her as well.
"Alright."
Of course, Shadow wasn't going to let the chance go.
But then,
BOOOOOOOOOOM
Another extremely powerful Aura burst out and suddenly, an absurd amount of Devouring Energy gathered around the area, instantly devouring the Power of Control that had slowed Amaya down.
Yes, her jealousy pushed Amaya Leander to break through as well.
And her first words after becoming a Primordial was...
"Get away, bitch."
"You come after h-"
"Get Away.
Bitch."

The Devourer repeated as she forcefully separated Nux and Aeliana, before wrapping herself around HER husband and surrounding themselves with Devouring Energy, that devoured the very concept of time itself, giving the two of them infinite amount of time to do whatever they wanted.
Yes, the Devourer couldn't control herself any further.
Nux was hers and HERS alone.
